Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work at nearly the same time as his Symphony No. 6, 'Pastorale'. Both symphonies premiered as part of an all-Beethoven program at the same concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. The second movement consists of a set of lyrical variations on two themes.

Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

Kylie Katich helps her best friend Hayley turn her blank room into a warm, personality-packed podcast studio; from custom curtain tracks and gallery walls to cozy furniture, the makeover gives Hayley a space that finally feels completely her own.

Journey to the Louisiana Delta for a look inside the home of Rebecca Vizard; from rooms draped in rich historic textiles to a whimsical "movie wagon" repurposed from a trailer base, Rebecca's creative spirit thrives in every corner of the house.

Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

Kylie transforms Mike and Tay's unfinished workout room into a sleek, motivating home gym complete with smart storage solutions; what starts with Grinch-green walls becomes a bright, elevated space built for serious workouts and serious style.

Matthew gets an all-access pass to rock royalty when he visits Carnie Wilson's Los Angeles home for a tour of her music studio and to whip up her Fall-to-Your-Knees Mac and Cheese while sharing laughs, stories, and even a little harmonizing.

Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

Matthew meets culinary powerhouse and Ethiopian-born Chef Fariyal Abdullahi for an exclusive tour of Hav & Mar, the sizzling seafood spot where she is the Executive Chef and gets a hands-on lesson in creating their signature dish, Doro Wat.

The one and only Chef Marcela Valladolid invites Matthew for a tour of her stunning historic San Diego home and lush edible garden plus a hands-on lesson in crafting the perfect taco and a signature salsa.

Travel to Tennessee to step inside the stunning European-inspired home of designer and antique curator Lauren Sullivan; this estate seamlessly blends classic architecture with a soulful collection of family heirlooms and historical treasures.

Bunny Williams opens the doors to her 1860s Falls Village estate; explore a rustic barn filled with antiques and an A-frame studio reimagined as a modern retreat; the tour concludes at the Greek temple-inspired pool house crafted from tree trunks.

Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays; first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary; just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.

On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

Jillian explores some of the most whimsical homes in Southern California: the famed Hobbit Apartments in Culver City, a home built into a bridge, and a historic Storybook home filled with charm and a storied past.

Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

Imagine stepping into a kaleidoscope, where colors, shapes, and textures collide; that's exactly what Jillian experiences as she explores the iconic Mosaic Tile House in beachy, boho Venice and the Rainbow House in the desert oasis of Palm Springs.
Julie breaks down the basic equations for taking the stress out of design.

Travel to Brooklyn to visit the vibrant townhouse of multidisciplinary artists Skylar Marshai and Temi Ibisanmi; featuring a vinyl room, curated treasures and a striking collection of artwork, every space reflects their eye for fashion and color.

In Rockbridge, Ohio, Levi tours The Pine at Dunlap Ridge which features a wall of windows that overlooks towering pines and farmland; then in Newry, Maine, Levi discovers The Cabin at Bear River, a luxurious escape inspired by Japandi design.

Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale; he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome; then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

Una anciana es envenenada por sus ambiciosos parientes, pero ella le deja la herencia a su gata, Miau, y a su criada.

Un ganadero mexicano viaja a España para reclamar unos sementales que le ha comprado a un noble español. Allí se encuentra con que el conde ha muerto y, en vez de los sementales, le ha dejado una casa en Granada ocupada por una familia de gitanos.
En España, dos hermanos compran a una gitana un billete de lotería que resulta ganador y vuelven con ella a México.
Dieter es un niño que está muy feliz con la pelota que su padre le regaló, un día esta va a parar al otro lado del muro.
El encargado de un teatro es asesinado para quitarle la nómina y su cadáver es escondido en un camerino.
Dos hombres falsifican herencias en Sevilla y conquistan a las hermosas mujeres del lugar.
Un hombre tiene en su poder la hipoteca de la hacienda de sus antiguos patrones y quiere casarse con la hija de ellos por la fuerza.
Elegida alcaldesa en su pueblo, la India María decide resolver los problemas del lugar... pero a su manera.
Después de una larga ausencia, un hombre regresa a su pueblo y cuenta todas sus aventuras con un toque de nostalgia.
Una actriz planea fugarse con un hombre casado que quiere divorciarse de su esposa y se mete en una serie de problemas.
Dos amigos que surten su nevería con nieve que recogen de los volcanes nevados reciben un dinero y mejoran el negocio.
Un buen hombre enfrenta problemas con su esposa, cuando ella decide llevar a su casa a toda su familia.
Un estafador organiza la evacuación de capitales a Ginebra para quedarse con el dinero ganado en especulaciones.

AI-powered smart glasses are changing how we interact with the world, while robotics and automation are helping reshape the future of American manufacturing. We explore these major shifts with Harrison Gross, CEO of Innovative Eyewear; Mark Sheahan.
Deep dive into the world of international defense and military issues.
Is Prenuvo's $2,500 body scan the future of healthcare? How Aescape's A.I. massage provides tailored relief anytime for everybody.

Explore the allure and rising momentum of gold as an alternative investment, especially as prices soar to all-time highs; from ancient empires to modern portfolios, discover why gold continues to shine as a hedge against inflation.
Discover the innovators behind NYC's changing landscape, from Central Park to Brooklyn's Domino Park; an inside look inside Soho's high-tech social wellness club.
Welcome to the NHRL, the world's best robot fighting league. NHRL hosts robot fights from the best competitors all over the world.
Deep dive into the world of international defense and military issues.
Cosmetic dentist designs celebrity smiles; new laser zaps unwanted tattoos; Elysium develops "Fountain of Youth" pill.
Many don't know it, but New York is a city that runs on steam; it's one of the few cities that relies on the old technology to heat some of its famous buildings.
New York has some famous bridges; these engineering examples have helped set the tone for how bridges around the world are designed.
New York City might be known as the concrete jungle, but its nearly 30,000 acres of park space have been an ever-present part of this metropolis.
Keeping the lights on in New York City is no easy task; as New York moves towards a greener future, the manner of generating electricity will have to evolve.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money podcast, Jeremy Schneider of Personal Finance Club explains how Trump Accounts work, who should open one, how they compare to 529 plans and custodial accounts (UGMA/UTMA), and why they may become.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money Podcast, hosts Mindy Jensen and Scott Trench sit down with Cody Berman to uncover how he achieved financial independence before age 30 and built a $5 million net worth through entrepreneurship, side hustles.
Eleven Madison Park leads the plant-based culinary revolution; Le Poisson Rouge reimagines the indie music scene; Air Company introduces the future of fuel.
Why office-to-apartment conversions are booming; infinite machine builds EV bikes for cities; inside Tribeca Immersive's AI judgment booth.
New York is known as one of the rattiest cities in America with an estimated population of close to 2 million rodents; here is how New York City rats out its rodents.
The yellow taxi cab is the quintessential New York City ride; the threat of ride-share apps and city scandal has left cab drivers to face debt.
Many things come to mind when thinking about New York, but how the city deals with its garbage is usually not one of them; here is how the city hauls away its trash.
New Yorkers create, on average, 1.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day that makes its way through 7,500 miles of pipes that make up the city's sewer system.
Un viejo artista cuenta la historia de María Candelaria quien se enamora perdidamente de Lorenzo Rafael, pero su amor se verá manchado por los prejuicios de un pueblo que la desprecia.
Una historia de Luis Buñuel, acerca de la pobreza y el crimen juvenil en los suburbios de la Ciudad de México.
Un hombre joven promete a su padrino encontrarles esposos buenos a sus cuatro hijas.
Una mujer se enamora de un hombre que tiene un garfio reemplazando su mano y al que abandona cuando cree tener lepra.
Un cura se ve en serios aprietos y debe disciplinar a su sobrina quien hace de las suyas en las fiestas locales.

José Luis, hijo de un hacendado, decide ir en contra de su familia casándose con Esperanza, una campesina humilde. Su padre lo echa de la casa para oponerse a la boda y porque se enteró de que es parte de la Revolución Mexicana. Unos falsos revolucionarios invaden la hacienda y asesinan al padre de José Luis, y así comienza una cadena de venganzas y tragedias.
Dos hombres y una mujer se enfrentan a la corrupción política y a sus propias pasiones.
La historia de Catalina de Erauso, una mujer que llegó a ser alférez y al confesar su género se salvó de la ejecución.
Un ranchero y una dama refinada se enamoran, pero la enemistad entre sus familias amenaza su relación amorosa.
Un grupo de jóvenes motociclistas compiten en una carrera peligrosa e inician un apasionado triángulo amoroso.
Un grupo de jóvenes se pierde en el desierto al caer su avión, mientras que lejos de ahí su empresario los espera.
La historia de una mujer con problemas mentales que tiene que enfrentar un embarazo.
Dos rancheros terminan su trabajo en la hacienda y van a la fiesta de un pueblo donde se gastan el dinero de su tío.
Un poeta celebra su cumpleaños en casa de su prometida pero se retira de pronto en medio de la lluvia y se enferma.
Un empresario a punto de ser descubierto en su infidelidad inventa una serie de mentiras que lo llevan a un gran enredo.
Una joven es tímida y reprimida por influencia de su madre, pero un día conoce a un músico y se desinhibe totalmente.
Un vendedor de cerveza es secuestrado por unos extraterrestres que le otorgan poderes para ser un excelente futbolista.

Chanfle Segundo es el utilero de un equipo de fútbol que, a fin de mejorar su situación económica, intenta vender una pistola para pagar los cuidados de su esposa embarazada. Debido a esto, se van creando divertidos enredos.

After Dick Harper (Jim Carrey) loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, Jane (Téa Leoni), turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, Dick and Jane actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it -- but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people. When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister (Alec Baldwin) actually swindled the company, they plot revenge.

Dave Skylark (James Franco) and his producer Aaron Rapaport (Seth Rogen) are the team behind the popular tabloid-TV show "Skylark Tonight." After learning that North Korea's Kim Jong-un (Randall Park) is a huge fan of the show, they successfully set up an interview with him, hoping to legitimize themselves as actual journalists. However, as Dave and Aaron prepare for their journey to Pyongyang, the CIA steps in, recruits them, and assigns them an incredible mission: Assassinate the dictator.

New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite.

After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love.

Inspired by the true story of indomitable Kuki Gallmann, the film tells of a beautiful and inquisitive woman who had the courage to escape from her comfortable yet monotonous life in Italy to start anew in the African wilderness with her son, Emanuele, and her new husband, Paolo. Gallmann faces great danger there but eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist.

In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton.

Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy.

For an awkward, self-conscious girl like Kiki (Julia Roberts), being the personal assistant to a beautiful megastar like Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones) isn't easy. But when she dutifully accepts the task of helping Gwen and her estranged husband Eddie (John Cusack) make it through one last public appearance masterminded by legendary press agent Lee Phillips (Billy Crystal), forever devoted Kiki finds that her job is about to get even harder when her and Eddie's relationship takes a romantic turn.

Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves to Southern California with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), but quickly finds himself the target of a group of bullies who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate and preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai.

After learning that his father is dying, karate master Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita) returns home to Okinawa, bringing his protégé, Daniel, with him. In Japan, Miyagi is surprised to discover that his old sweetheart, Yukie, has remained single. Meanwhile, Daniel is attracted to Yukie's niece, Kumiko. But romance must be put on hold while Daniel and Miyagi deal with local bullies and long-harbored grudges.

In this bittersweet, classic musical drama, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on Broadway. Valued for her vocal and comedic talents by the renowned theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld (Walter Pidgeon), Fanny thrives, but her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nick Arnstein (Omar Sharif), is another story.

When Joanna Drayton (Katharine Houghton), a free-thinking white woman, and black doctor John Prentice (Sidney Poitier) become engaged, they travel to San Francisco to meet her parents. Matt Drayton (Spencer Tracy) and his wife Christina (Katharine Hepburn) are wealthy liberals who must confront the latent racism the coming marriage arouses. Also attending the Draytons' dinner are Prentice's parents (Roy E. Glenn Sr., Beah Richards), who vehemently disapprove of the relationship.

Christopher Pride (Jerry Lewis) has been offered an important commission in Paris but can't convince his girlfriend, Dr. Elizabeth Acord (Janet Leigh), to take some time off from her psychiatric practice. Elizabeth is worried about three of her female patients, all of whom are extremely hostile toward men and very needy. Christopher, anxious to leave for France, decides to impersonate the ideal man for each of Elizabeth's patients, in hopes of lessening their dependency on her.

During World War II, Englishwoman Stella (Sophia Loren) is involved with Capt. Ford (Trevor Howard), who commands a military tugboat. Ford's mission is dangerous because his slow-moving ship is an easy target. Eventually, he is gunned down in action and Capt. Ross (William Holden) replaces him. Before long, Ross also begins a relationship with Stella, but she warns the newcomer that she may be cursed -- captain after captain has come through her door, and each has met the same grim fate at sea.
A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

After saving the life of his royal father's usurper, Pelias (Douglas Wilmer), whom he fails to recognize, Jason (Todd Armstrong) is encouraged by the conniving murderer to begin a quest in search of the Golden Fleece. In doing so, Pelias hopes for Jason's death to thwart the prophecy that he will reclaim the throne. Along the journey, Jason is protected by the goddess Hera (Honor Blackman), and his crew includes Hercules (Nigel Green) and Acastus (Gary Raymond), a saboteur planted by Pelias.

Theodora Lynn (Irene Dunne) is secretly the author of a salacious novel written under a pen name. She must hide her identity from the residents of her small, conservative Connecticut town, who disapprove of the book. When Theodora goes to New York to visit her publisher (Thurston Hall), she meets the book's cover artist, Michael Grant (Melvyn Douglas), who tries to convince her to reveal herself as the real author. When Theodora falls for Michael, she soon finds that he has secrets of his own.

Distraught when her middle-aged lover breaks a date with her, 21-year-old Toni Simmons (Goldie Hawn) attempts suicide. Impressed by her action, her lover, dentist Julian Winston (Walter Matthau) reconsiders marrying Toni, but he worries about her insistence on honesty. Having fabricated a wife and three children, Julian readily accepts when his devoted nurse, Stephanie (Ingrid Bergman), who has secretly loved Julian for years, offers to act as his wife and demand a divorce.

Ellen Grant (Lucille Ball) is the worst student at her secretarial school, yet surprisingly, she is hired by real estate agent Dick Richmond (William Holden). It turns out that Dick's real estate office is just a front for a betting operation. When Ellen unknowingly takes a large bet from Dick's old flame, Peggy (Janis Carter), Peggy demands that Dick must either pay up or run off with her. It's up to the dizzy Miss Grant to find a way to extract Dick from this mess.

American Mark Thackeray (Sidney Poitier) recently received his degree in engineering, but cannot find work. To make ends meet, he takes a job as a teacher in a rough London East End school populated mostly with troublemakers who were rejected from other schools for their behavior. While the students at first see Thackeray as just another teacher open for ridicule and bullying, his calm demeanor and desire to see them succeed gradually earn him their respect.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

In the 1870s, Marshal Wyatt Earp (Bruce Cowling) calls upon Dodge City, Kan., Sheriff Bat Masterson (George Montgomery) to track down rancher Merrick (John Maxwell), who is accused of murder. But, thanks to some proof held by local Native American Chief Yellow Hawk (Jay Silverheels), Masterson realizes Merrick might be the victim of a frame-up. So, with the help of Earp and gunfighter Doc Holliday (James Griffith), Masterson sets out to find those who are really behind the killing.
A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.
A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.
Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.
A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.
After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

Bounty hunter Ben Brigade (Randolph Scott) is on his way to California with his prisoner, Billy John (James Best), who is unaware that Brigade is really after his brother, Frank (Lee Van Cleef). The pair stop at a frontier post and find themselves defending the poorly guarded settlement from a Native American assault. When the widow Mrs. Lane (Karen Steele) decides to accompany them to Santa Cruz, Brigade enlists the aid of two outlaws who may have a hidden agenda of their own.

In Texas, gunfighter Brazos Kane (Randolph Scott) decides to lay down his guns for good and rides out to visit his best friend -- only to witness his murder. When Brazos takes the body to the nearby ranch of the powerful Banner (Griff Barnett), the rancher accuses him of the murder. Brazos leaves Banner's daughter, Bess (Barbara Britton), a vital piece of evidence in the crime, and then must evade Banner and a crooked sheriff as he reluctantly takes up arms to prove his innocence.
A wildcatter (Faye Dunaway), her father (John Mills) and a boozing drifter (George C. Scott) defend her oil derrick in 1913 Oklahoma.
Tras un terremoto, la vida de las personas cambia. Ante las adversidades hay que abandonar los prejuicios y aceptar la ayuda.
Luisa es una actriz exitosa. Su hija Miriam la apoya en todo. Cuando está por casarse, Luisa descubre que Ulises se ha convertido en un obsesivo.
Katy es una niña talentosa e inteligente. Sus padres le exigen mucho y limitan su vida social. Ellos deberán entender que su hija tiene personalidad y gustos propios.
Bertho y Harold son amigos y alumnos ejemplares. Por lo tanto, competirán por la oportunidad de una beca. Al final, verán que su oportunidad es lo más importante.
Valente, un joven humilde, se encuentra una computadora en un parque. Él decide quedársela en lugar de devolvérsela a la dueña.
Tras la muerte de su padre y la enfermedad de su madre, Santiago cambia su vida. Decide emprender un nuevo negocio.
Violeta y Sara buscan respuestas al enterarse de que son adoptadas. Ambas valoran el amor que les han dado sus madres.
Un joven se vuelve muy celoso, arruinando su hermosa relación con la mujer que ama.
Carmen vive sometida por su hermano Josué y su padre. Al lastimar a su hermano, tiene que huir. Con la ayuda de sus amigos podrá cambiar su vida.
Alex y Berenice se reencuentran en la secundaria luego de varios años. Ella siente algo por Alex, pero cree que él es gay y lo trata mal.
Pilar sufre bullying por su peso. Por otro lado, Palmira es admirada. Ambas desean cambiar y juntas podrán superar sus problemas.
A woman spends almost two decades searching for the man who kidnapped her from her bedroom and left her for dead when she was 8 years old.
Authorities in Colorado race to catch a serial rapist before he attacks again.
The 1979 murder of Janet Walsh frustrates police for decades, then DNA technology plays a key role in solving this 30-year-old cold case.
William Coday fell in love with Colombian immigrant Gloria Gomez; when he lived in Germany, he'd thought he had a similar love; Gloria Gomez's life would come to a similarly brutal end.
Betty Broderick was a socialite who led a perfect life with a successful husband and kids until it all came crashing down in divorce, and murder.

Small-town plumber John Cataneo fixes other people's homes for a living, until death came knocking on his front door; to find out who wanted him dead, police investigate the contents of Cataneo's own home, and get the leak they need.

What begins as another sun-soaked day in Boca Raton, Fla., ends in blood-soaked violence, leaving a mother of three a quadriplegic; police find that this seemingly random act may not have been so random after all.
A Florida billionaire ignores a stop sign, killing the young driver of another car; a celebrity publicist backs her SUV into a crowd of people and flees the scene.
High school staffer Pamela Smart has a love affair with a student and convinces him to kill her husband.
Los Angeles police respond to a bank heist and find they are outgunned by the robbers; citizens and police run for cover in a brazen deadly shootout.
Secrets come to light as police investigate Jeffrey Pyne in the beating death of his mother; Maurice Clarett turns from football to crime.

John Hinkley Jr. shoots President Ronald Reagan, reportedly to gain the attention of a young Hollywood star; a lab worker derails the criminal justice system, resulting in freedom for convicted criminals.
Elderly widows target homeless men in plots to cash in on murder; an art investor bilks Hollywood celebrities out of millions of dollars.
In a case that shocked the nation, a mother and son stand trial for the unthinkable; Shanda Vander Ark, once a promising law clerk, now faces murder charges in the death of her own child.

Richard Kananen Sr. abused his wife and three children so badly that no one bothered to report him missing when he disappeared; when his wife Marilyn vanished fifteen years later, it became clear that the evil in their father had been passed down.

Paula Gutierrez fell in love as a teen with Nestor 'Chino' de Jesus; his manipulative and abusive behavior turned their romance into a nightmare that ended with Paula facing life in prison for a murder that she didn't commit.

When a well-respected psychiatrist and his adult son are killed as they sleep, police are baffled by the apparent randomness until an arrest in an unrelated crime leads them to the least likely of suspects.

The night begins with a birthday celebration for Susan Sutton; it ends with a nightmare when a man breaks in and opens fire, killing Susan and blinding her husband; when police track down the shooter, they can't believe who he said put him up to it.

After leaving a work party late at night, Ramona Krotinea's body was discovered in the trunk of her own car the next day, and police need to reconstruct who and what happened in the intervening hours.

When flames tore through a Buffalo, New York home in 2018, the investigation revealed a toxic relationship and a hot-tempered arsonist, Frank Bredt, Jr. Now Bredt is talking about his crime from behind bars. In this episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott revisits the fire, the evidence, and the unraveling timeline - exposing a jilted lover hidden behind smoke and destruction and giving viewers an unfiltered look into the chilling death of an innocent mother.

In his first ever television interview, killer Thomas Gilbert, Jr. discusses the murder that shook New York's elite. The Princeton-educated Gilbert became a tabloid obsession when he shot his father after his $1,000 allowance was cut off. But in this unique installment of Interview With a Killer, Gilbert appears to be a far cry from his once golden upbringing. Host David Scott explores his long history of mental illness and the privileged pressure cooker that shaped his downfall.
Despite multiple investigations, Kay Wenal's 2008 murder remains unsolved with no suspects or motives; however, detectives believe someone knows something that can help police crack this case.
Two women fight to keep the man convicted of killing their mother over 20 years earlier in prison, though he maintains his innocence.
The investigation into the murder of a beloved Florida doctor reveals his dark, secret past.

Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone, including settler Elder Bixby; his beautiful daughter, Alicia; Fallon's fair-minded employee, Yukon Burn; and his right-hand man, Frenchy LeCroix -- and his cheating ways create unlikely bedfellows.

A train carrying a Japanese delegation with a ceremonial sword for President Grant is robbed by bandits led by Link (Charles Bronson) and Gauche (Alain Delon). When Gauche double-crosses him and leaves him for dead, Link is ordered to team up with Kuroda Jubei (Toshirô Mifune), one of the ambassador's guards, who has a week to recover the sword or commit suicide. Hoping to find out from Gauche where the gang buried their spoils before Kuroda can kill him, Link tries to escape from the samurai.
Two Montana cowboys (Jerry Reed, Tom Selleck) head for Nashville and help a woman (Morgan Fairchild) find her sister.
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.
Divided by the Civil War, two brothers (Ronald Reagan, Bruce Bennett) reunite against Apaches in Arizona.
Bart is forced into a political battle when he is threatened with death unless he delivers some mysterious documents he has never seen.
Bret is fleeced and enlists everyone's help to reclaim the money.

Preston Biggs (Kevin Sorbo), the former sheriff of a small Wild West town, is reeling from the death of his wife and has succumbed to the bottle. He gets a chance at redemption when he is asked to escort three women (Jillian Armenante, Dominique Swain, Felicia Day) from the prairie back to civilization. Along the way, they meet Olivia (Jamie Anne Allman), an outlaw desperately on the run from her former partner (Lance Henriksen). Preston must pick himself up and defend all the women.
A young man wants an education despite his uncle's objection.
Bret and Bart risk their lives against outlaws blasting through the roof of a bank.
The losers of a poker game challenge Cheyenne to a duel.
Cheyenne stops in a small border town.
The North Fork stagecoach must stop at the McCain ranch because of a severe snowstorm.
Two cowhands submit Lucas' name to a matchmaker.

When Mac (Jerry O'Connell) goes to the northwestern Montana wilderness to join the National Forest Service as a ranger in 1919, he is little more than a cocksure 17-year-old, but his tough-as-nails boss, Bill Bell (Sam Elliott), sees to it that he becomes a man. Since Bell has a reputation for being the best ranger, Mac wants nothing more than to follow in his idol's footsteps -- though it often leads to some missteps. As time passes, the two develop a friendship, but Mac has much to learn.
The team tries to find a witness to the contract killing of a woman outside a nightclub; Jane puts herself in the line of fire.

After her father dies of a heart attack, Julie returns home to see her mother, Gail. But Gail is not herself these days, acting bizarrely and under the control of Warren, a highly intelligent criminal who wants to get his hands on her fortune.

In 2008, Casey Anthony was charged with first degree murder for the disappearance of her daughter, Caylee. In new interviews, Robyn Adams shares how Casey lured her into a friendship, and Silvia Hernandez's life was ruined because of the two women.
A woman is raped, shot three times and left for dead; a man is caught in a blizzard that threatens to bury him alive; two boys survive a plane crash.
An ex-convict seeks revenge against his former wife, who married an aspiring politician.
Upset about her parents' divorce, a teen (Brittney Wilson) develops a hostile relationship with her pregnant stepmother (Melora Hardin).
An author (Sara Rue) meets a young student who seems to be the reincarnation of her late friend.
Jilted by her latest beau (Cameron Bancroft), one woman (Cynthia Preston) vows revenge against another (Brandy Ledford) by stealing away the latter's teenage son.

Jane (Chelsea Hobbs) gives up her plans for law school to become an actress, and when money becomes tight, she starts working as a go-go dancer. As the job rapidly becomes an obsession, Jane loses touch with her family and her true self.

A 10-year-old adopted girl discovers that she is related to a royal German family. Feeling special for the first time, she becomes an entitled, angry child. As her fascination with being a princess grows, the girl begins to lose her sanity.
The team's skills are tested when the mummified remains of a woman are found; Jane tries to recover from a devastating loss.
The team helps Korsak investigate a cold case; Jane refuses to believe that she is not ready to go back on duty.
Jane and Maura find a man who died in a bathtub full of ice; while trying to stay cool during a heatwave, Angela discovers a spicy tea that brings unexpected romantic consequences.
A notable county prosecutor is arrested for murder; when Angela hears that Maura is planning to meet Jack's daughter, she sets out to educate Maura about the interests of children today.

Rodolfo descubre que tanto su hijo como Adrián tienen golpes y, aunque José Armando no le dice la razón, toma la decisión de despedir a su empleado. En tanto, Esmeralda le cuenta a Dominga cómo la corrieron de la casa grande y ella le hace un regalo.

Eduardo lleva a cabo sus planes para rescatar a Liliana. Fernanda le asegura a Santiago que Bárbara es la responsable de haber matado a su madre. Fernanda y Santiago idean un plan.

Santos se pone celoso al enterarse de que Rubén estuvo ayudando a María con el caso de Susanito. Santos confronta a Rubén por haber intentado besar a María. Rubén le hace creer a María que Santos le dio una golpiza.

Santos se defiende violentamente de las acusaciones de Rubén y queda mal con María. Concho le informa a Coloso que Santos es el nuevo administrador y jefe de los mariachis del bar. Coloso le dice a Rodrigo que renunció al bar.
Coloso decide regresar a su ciudad de origen al saber que Santos podría ser su nuevo jefe. María intenta hablar con Santos, pero él se niega y decide alejarse de ella.

Santos recuerda los buenos momentos que pasó al lado de María. María se pone celosa al ver a Elvira intentar besar a Santos. Susanito queda en libertad tras no encontrarse pruebas que demuestren que él mató a Fabián.

María sufre al ver que Santos no quiere estar más con ella. Ana y sus amigos preparan una fiesta para celebrar la libertad de Susanito. Susanito se prepara para volver a cantar en el bar y poder recuperar el tiempo perdido.
José Armando no se explica por qué besó a Esmeralda, pero cree que debe adelantar su boda. Esmeralda reconoce que siente algo por el joven Peñarreal. Crisanta descubre dónde vive Dominga.

Lucio le prohíbe a Esmeralda volver a encontrarse con José Armando y le habla a Juana sobre su temor de que alguien pueda alejarla de él. Cuando Adrián se entera del beso entre el médico y la joven, lo enfrenta.

In this revered Western, Ethan Edwards (John Wayne) returns home to Texas after the Civil War. When members of his brother's family are killed or abducted by Comanches, he vows to track down his surviving relatives and bring them home. Eventually, Edwards gets word that his niece Debbie (Natalie Wood) is alive, and, along with her adopted brother, Martin Pawley (Jeffrey Hunter), he embarks on a dangerous mission to find her, journeying deep into Comanche territory.

John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West.
Matt gets tipped off about gang that's shanghaiing sailors.
Matt faces a court battle when he tries to have a man convicted on circumstantial evidence.
A lonely woman shelters a wounded fugitive against her husband's wishes.
A man single-handedly runs a frontier town.

When arrogant and stubborn Civil War hero Lieutenant Colonel Owen Thursday (Henry Fonda) arrives in Arizona with his daughter, Philadelphia (Shirley Temple), to assume command of the Fort Apache outpost, he clashes with level-headed Captain Kirby York (John Wayne). Viewing the local Native Americans through an ignorantly negative lens, Thursday is determined to engage them in battle for his own glory, despite the warnings of York -- an act of folly that will have dire consequences.

Enigmatic gunslinger Shane rides into a small Wyoming town with hopes of quietly settling down as a farmhand. Taking a job on homesteader Joe Starrett's farm, Shane is drawn into a battle between the townsfolk and ruthless cattle baron Rufus Ryker. Shane's growing attraction to Starrett's wife, Marian, and his fondness for their son Joey, who idolizes Shane, force Shane to realize that he must thwart Ryker's plan.
A Confederate captain (Alan Ladd) and a couple (Lizabeth Scott, Arthur Kennedy) face Quantrill's Raiders out West.
A drifter (Alan Ladd) fakes a telltale birthmark in a scheme to bilk a rancher (Charles Bickford) by posing as his long-lost son.

After discovering a fortune in gold nuggets, Shaun Garrett (Roger Moore) and his partner, Jim Rainbolt (Clint Walker), make their way toward the town of Seven Saints to redeem it for cash. Word of their find reaches bandit McCracken (Gene Evans), who comes after them. The men hide their treasure and fend off McCracken with the help of Doc Gates (Chill Wills), before escaping to recover at the ranch of Rainbolt's friend, Amos Gondora (Robert Middleton), waiting until they can retrieve the gold.

Union soldier Maj. Towns (Rhodes Reason) asks fur trapper and Indian scout Luther "Yellowstone" Kelly (Clint Walker) to scout for the Army in Sioux territory. Kelly ventures into the area, only to be taken prisoner by the Sioux. Since Kelly saved the life of Chief Gall (John Russell) years before, the chief promises to free him if Kelly treats wounded Arapaho maiden Wahleeah (Andra Martin). Soon Kelly and the recovered Wahleeah are caught between Towns' soldiers and the vengeful Sioux.

Lupita habla con Pilar y le dice que se la pasa bien con Tomás, pero con el solo escuchar el nombre de Nico, todo se le olvida. El padre de Diego le regala un auto lo cual le molesta, porque solo trata de comprar su cariño.

Valeria le propone a Franco vivir juntos, él le dice que lo ha pensado, pero no puede porque Mía es su prioridad y debe estar libre para ella. Debido a la ruptura de Nico y Karen, el padre de ella le prohíbe ir al café y olvidarse de la banda.

La banda se entera de que Gastón estuvo en el café y los vio tocar. Galia habla con Pilar y le dice que cada una deberá enfrentar sus errores. Mía pelea con Miguel por culpa de Luz Viviana, ella amenaza con contarle a su papá que está en la banda.
Giovanni logra escapar de La Logia, Miguel y los demás chicos denuncian con el director que Giovanni y Teo no están en el colegio. Tomás y Lupita están discutiendo y escuchan un golpe.

Afortunadamente, Teo no está muerto, Enrique y los chicos lo reaniman mientras esperan a los paramédicos. Carlo le dice a Alma que alguien debe poner a Roberta en su lugar. Pascual no cree sobre la existencia de La Logia.
José visita a Teo en el hospital y le dice que lo ama. Alma toma la decisión de irse debido al comportamiento de Roberta. Giovanni les confiesa que sabe dónde están los archivos de La Logia.

La habitación de la azotea arde en llamas, Pascual y Galia corren para controlar el fuego, sin saber que Diego y los demás alumnos. El director Pascual y Mendiola no saben qué hacer con los alumnos que forman La Logia.

Pascual y el Lic. Mendiola llegan a un acuerdo para que nadie se entere sobre "La Logia". Roberta trata de hablar con su madre, pero Alma sigue muy dolida. Giovanni es expulsado del colegio. Pilar se confiesa con su padre.

Enrique le hace saber a todo el colegio que la escuela opera bajo una logia y León sugiere clausurar el colegio. Carlo le propone una nueva oportunidad de trabajo en Estados Unidos a Alma. Juan discute con su papá por haberse unido a la logia.

Miguel ya no quiere trabajar para Franco, pero él le pide que vaya con Mía. Mía le pide a Alma que hable con su papá para que la deje cantar en el grupo. Alma le confiesa a Franco que sus hijos falsificaron sus firmas.

Ante el problema de la gaceta, Miguel defiende a Mía y dice que él es su novio. Roberta le dice a Luján que Teo se muere por ella, pero Luján no le cree. Gastón agradece a Miguel por haber dicho que él es el novio de Mía.

El director del colegio le informa a Enrique que está despedido, pero él no quiere. Durante la cena, Mía pierde el control y al destapar la champaña, moja a todos. Luz intenta seducir a Miguel en el baño de hombres, pero Mía entra y le pega a Luz.

Mía le reclama a Miguel que vaya a salir con Luz Viviana. Gastón se enfurece al descubrir a Miguel y Mía besándose. Todos los chicos se sorprenden al encontrarse en su viaje a Canadá. Franco se entera de que Carlos y Alma piensan vivir en Nueva York.

Franco se encuentra a Alma en un restaurante, pero se entera su novia y se molesta. Lupita le cuenta a Pilar que Tomás la besó. Mia le propone a Diego tener un romance en Canadá, al igual que Miguel a Roberta. Enrique tiene una discusión con Renata.

Vico, Celina y José pretenden juntar a Mía con Miguel y a Roberta con Diego. Teo insiste en que José sea su novio. Todos esquían en la nieve y se divierten. Alma está triste por Roberta. La mamá de Miguel busca a Franco.

Gandía despide a Madariaga del colegio. Mía se pone celosa por Roberta, pero Miguel le confiesa que ellos son solo amigos. Pepa le confiesa a Alma que Roberta ya sabe que se irá a vivir a Nueva York y llora por eso. Diego besa a Roberta.
Mía y Miguel se besan, pero Gastón los interrumpe con una llamada. Por su parte, Madariaga recuerda las clases en la escuela y se pone nostálgico. Además, Diego confunde a Roberta con Paola.

Renata acusa a Madariaga de ser un asesino. Georgi le confiesa a Roberta el inmenso amor que siente por Luján. Roberta y sus compañeros del colegio idean un plan para demostrarle a Renata que Madariaga es un buen hombre.
Mendiola le exige a Pascual que expulse a Madariaga del colegio. Roberta y Mía sospechan que Alma y Franco están enamorados. Renata le confiesa a Plutarco que Mendiola es su padre.

Roberta le cuenta a la prensa el amor y la admiración que siente por Alma. Alma decide detener su gira internacional para poder pasar más tiempo con Roberta. Teo idea un plan para saber si Luján está interesada en Georgi.

Roberta besa a Facundo para agradecerle por todo el apoyo que le ha dado. Tres mujeres se aprovechan del estado de ebriedad de Diego, Giovanni y Tomás para robarles su dinero. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para alejar a Miguel y Mia.
Diego se encela al saber que Roberta está saliendo con Facundo. Nico se alegra al saber que Lupita no ha dejado de amarlo. Mía idea un plan para celebrar su cumpleaños en el colegio.

Roberta y José son reprobadas por copiarse en un examen. Por su parte, Franco cancela la fiesta de cumpleaños de Mía por la broma que le hizo a Valeria. Además, Vico le aconseja a Giovanni que deje de actuar.

Mía encuentra a Miguel en su closet. Por otro lado, Diego le dice a Roberta que le molesta verla con Facundo y la besa apasionadamente. Luego, Angelita cita a Miguel para contarle sobre su sobrino Gastón.
Gastón sorprende a Miguel investigando todo sobre él y le pone una trampa. Mientras tanto, Roberta le reclama a su mamá por organizar la fiesta de Mía. Diego se queda sin frenos.
Giovanni y Vico se quedan encerrados en la cafetería toda la noche. Mientras tanto, Diego destruye el coche de Simón. Luego, Diego inventa que perdió la memoria y que no recuerda a Roberta.

Ludovico y Federica se retan para ver si son capaces de intercambiar sus actividades, Federica tendrá que ir a la oficina y Ludovico se encargará de los hijos y las labores del hogar.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.
Movie, Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure

Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island.
In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

A cab driver realizes his current fare is a hit man that has been having him drive around from mark to mark until the last witness to a crime is dead. When the cabbie finally figures out the truth, he must prevent the assassin from wiping out his last witness without becoming the next in the professional killer's line of casualties.

After its boat capsizes, a group of migrants is rescued by rich Europeans who offer shelter on the island where they are vacationing. The miracle becomes a nightmare when the saviors reveal their true plan and turn into ruthless man hunters.

Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

Wren (Victoria Justice) is a high-school senior who can't wait to get away from her dysfunctional family. On Halloween, Wren's mother decides to go out with her much-younger boyfriend, leaving Wren to look after little brother Albert. When Wren is distracted by an invitation to the party of the year, Albert disappears into a sea of trick-or-treaters. Enlisting the aid of her sassy friend, April (Jane Levy), and two other classmates, Wren sets out on a frantic search for her sibling.

Playful Pee-wee Herman (Paul Reubens) operates a fantastical farm with talking animals and hot-dog trees. One day, after a giant tornado hits, Pee-wee finds a circus has landed in his yard. He befriends the manager, Mace Montana (Kris Kristofferson), and develops a crush on a trapeze performer (Valeria Golino), even though he already has a fiancée (Penelope Ann Miller). Pee-wee tries to excite the town about the new circus, but most of the residents want it gone and harass Pee-wee because of it.
Chaos ensues when a meteor hits the Earth carrying alien life forms that give new meaning to the term survival of the fittest.
The misadventures of three ingenious orphans and the villainous actor Count Olaf who wants their enormous fortune.

Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies.

Ralph Kramden (Cedric the Entertainer) drives a bus in New York City but dreams of something more. Unfortunately, none of Ralph's business ideas -- which often incorporate his best friend, Ed (Mike Epps) -- have panned out. Knowing their husbands will never get them out of the city, Ralph's wife, Alice (Gabrielle Union), and Ed's wife, Trixie (Regina Hall), pool their savings to purchase a house in the suburbs. But once the men find out about the secret stash, they might just blow it all.

Adapted from a comedy sketch on HBO's The Chris Rock Show, Pootie Tang (Lance Crouther) is the ultimate superhero. A cool-walking, smooth-talking lady's man, Pootie is a hero and a role model to all the kids of the neighborhood. Everybody looks up to Pootie except evil Dick Lecter (Robert Vaughn), CEO of Lecter Corp., a company that makes cigarettes, alcohol and fast food. Pootie shows cool determination and strength to prevail over Lecter and his minions.

In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).
Movie, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Adventure, Thriller

A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public.
Los pequeños bailarines se enfrentan en una prueba de mambo. El cantante Christian Nodal se presenta en el escenario. Albertano sorprende en el programa.
La cantante internacional Filippa Giordano se presenta en el escenario. Los capitanes se enfrentan en una prueba de preguntas y respuestas. Se vive la segunda eliminación de la competencia.

El cantante Flex se presenta en el escenario de Pequeños Gigantes. Los bailarines se enfrentan con ritmos de cumbia y merengue. Los capitanes concursan con los jueces en pruebas de habilidad y destreza.
El cantante Ricardo Montaner se presenta en el escenario. Los capitanes se convierten en actores y compiten por un Oscarito. Se vive la última sentencia.
Alicia Villarreal, Lucero y La Sonora Dinamita se presentan en el escenario. Los capitanes se enfrentan en divertidos retos.

El último programa de la competencia al lado de grandes artistas como Carlos Rivera, Ha-Ash y Espinoza Paz, quienes se presentan en el escenario para cantar junto a los finalistas y conocer a los ganadores.
Los pequeños demostrarán su gran talento en un reto de baile y canto. Verónica Castro, Miguel Bosé, Albertano y Karol Sevilla tendrán la dura tarea de seleccionar a los miembros de los escuadrones.

La batalla entre los seis escuadrones da inicio y cada punto será vital para salvarse de la sentencia. Los pequeños demostrarán su talento a través de su carisma, su voz, sus pasos de baile y sus increíbles habilidades.

Uno de los seis escuadrones dice adiós y antes de irse, Tadeo le hace una petición especial a los jueces. Los capitanes cuentan sus historias de vida de una manera muy peculiar. Los pequeños bailarines muestran sus mejores pasos.

Grandes estrellas de la música acompañan a los pequeños en el reto de canto. La bailarina argentina, Laurita Fernández, se une como jueza invitada para calificar los retos de baile. Los capitanes rinden homenaje a Verónica Castro.

Es noche de sentencia y los cinco escuadrones darán lo mejor en el escenario. María León se une como invitada al panel de jueces. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto de "Gali dice" para ganar un punto extra.

After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

In South Devon, Joe and Claire's family house will be a giant sculpture inspired by the local landscape, 70 meters long and featuring 34 enormous angled zinc shards jutting out in all directions. But it proves astonishingly complicated to build.

On a Scottish country estate architect Lain and his wife Jenny build an enormous new black, square building inside a beautiful old walled garden, connecting it right through the high garden wall into a dilapidated gardeners' bothy on the other side.

Bereaved Gretta returns from Malaysia to build a single-story, burnt wood and glass pavilion on the land of her sister Mary and brother-in-law Fernando. Also designed by her nephew Carlos, it's a real family affair, a story of recovery and renewal.

Architectural designer Dan and interior designer Nina want to build a sleek, unique larch clad family house. But their biggest challenge is to convert a swamp on the plot into a sweeping, biodiverse waterscape with a beautiful natural swimming pond.

Ex-advertising man Geoff builds a dramatically cantilevered house on a flood plain in Essex. It's one of the challenges of his life: a flood resistant architectural marvel on the coast, designed to survive a one in a thousand-year flood event.

Kevin McCloud returns to East Sussex where concrete fanatic Adrian and wife Megan's cutting-edge concrete bunker is now complete. Is this raw, exposed concrete home really the ultimate 21st century country house?

After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

Tyler and Lindsay love their waterfront lifestyle, but desperately need a family home where they can put down roots. Drew and Jonathan help them find a property in their exclusive neighborhood with minimal compromise.

Busy parents Dorothy and John have been crashing in his parents' basement, and with baby number two on the way they're desperate to find a home of their own. It's a race against time, and the Property Brothers step in with a plan.
Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.
Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.
Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.
Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.
Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.
Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.
Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.
TV and radio host Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera or poor man's cooking.

Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.
Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.
The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.
Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe.
Acclaimed chef Michael Caines takes Fred to Burgundy to amazing places to eat serving the finest French country cooking and exquisite pâtisserie.
Top chefs in England take Fred Sirieix to experience amazing restaurants where they genuinely love to eat.
Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza all delicious but affordable.
Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws.
Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy.
In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties.

Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food".

Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.
Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map.
Frankie heads to Santa Fe investigating New Mexican cuisines eating green chile burgers, poblano chile stews, and sweet blue-corn pancakes.

Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin's best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin' beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird, but the food is fabulous.

Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He'll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he'll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot.

Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio's best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls.

Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.
