In the spirit of Halloween, Piper dresses up in various costumes to scare her co-workers; Cooper insists on shadowing Sam.

Danny and Mike see a strip-club owner get physical with a stripper; Delinda advocates for better rights for exotic dancers in the city; Piper enlists Sam's help to find a racy video that she does not want people to see.

The casino plays host to an environmentally friendly conference; Danny questions Delinda's plan for a new "green" lifestyle; Sam tries to capitalize on high rollers looking for love; Cooper shows a new side of himself when a mystery woman arrives.

Danny gets a surprise visit from the fire marshal and his alcoholic uncle; Mike keeps an eye on the casino's Hand on Hard Bodies competition; Cooper forces Sam to help a contestant; thieves break into the casino.

The effects of the Montecito robbery reverberate all over Las Vegas; Danny tries to fend off federal agencies' accusations; Delinda wants Cooper and Sam to apologize to each other; Piper and Mike help a widow carry out her husband's last wishes.
Mike begins to doubt his place in Las Vegas; Sam invites a client to visit the casino for the holidays; Delinda and Piper plan a Hot Santa contest to win the casino charity competition.
Danny and Mike head to Wyoming to buy a horse; Delinda looks for a new chef for the casino restaurant; Piper hides from her ex.

Bounty hunters and FBI agents descend on the Montecito when they track a fugitive from justice to the area; Sam tries to help one of her whales pick up the pieces of his broken life; Piper throws a post-New Year's party, and cash starts rolling in.
Piper gets in trouble with the gaming commission; Sam gets caught speeding and must attend traffic school; Danny and Delinda meet a "perfect" pair at a parenting class.

Sam gets help from The Cleaner when she needs to get rid of evidence after her whales visit a strip club; Mike and Piper (Camille Guaty) sample the wares of a hot new bartender they are trying to lure to the Montecito.
Piper's evaluation for the Concierge of the Year award tests her skills; Danny and Mike decide to play in a two-on-two basketball competition where the stakes become more than they anticipated.
Cooper, Danny and Mike are suspicious of a man (Terry Bradshaw) who has a nearly perfect winning streak; Sam's whale brings his grandmother (Kathryn Joosten) to the casino to play bingo.
Thieves try to steal a rare stamp that is up for auction at the Montecito, taking Danny, Piper, Mitch and the surveillance room hostage; Mike's mom discovers that he is married.
Big Ed Deline leads a surveillance team charged with maintaining security at one of the largest casinos in Sin City; protégé Danny McCoy must foil a team of high-tech cheats.
The body of Danny's childhood friend is found in the desert; Ed conceals the identity of an ultraconservative senator; Mary contends with an actor who takes his role as King Arthur too seriously.
Danny and Ed become suspicious when a high roller cashes in chips but never plays a hand; Ed's cousin meets the woman of his dreams at the roulette wheel and decides to get married immediately.
Cheaters plan to score $10 million with the help of the best pit boss in Vegas -- Nessa; a psychic warns Mary of an audience member's death; Sam plays matchmaker for a lonely lady.
Danny and Ed hunt for a sexual predator targeting hotel guests; Danny and Mike suspect three MIT students of planning an electronic heist when they arrive with the latest high-tech equipment.
When Ed leaves Danny in charge of the hotel, a computer glitch causes hundreds of guests to be locked out of their rooms.
A con artist (Alana De La Garza) scams the daughter of a surveillance specialist into exchanging counterfeit chips for cash; Mary helps a couple down on their luck with tickets to see Wayne Newton.
A stalker disrupts a pop diva's (Sheryl Lee Ralph) performance at the hotel; Ed reunites with a former partner (Mimi Rogers); Sam tries to evict a guest lodged in a prime suite who refuses to gamble.
Sam brings one of the premier high rollers (Michael Paul Chan) to the Montecito, promising to arrange a rare reunion with his two high-profile daughters.
Danny and Ed search the hotel when a member of a husband-and-wife magic troupe vanishes; Mike runs into an old friend from college.

Ed and Danny referee clashes between rival camps during the premier boxing match of the year; Danny threatens to cancel the fight after the theft of a manager's prosthetic limb; Ed questions the fluctuating odds on an undercard fight.
Ed's former CIA buddy (Alec Baldwin) installs a security system which immediately detects a breach made by a computer hacker staying at the hotel.
A hotel guest is shot dead on the casino floor during a blackout; trapped Danny and Mary rehash old feelings; Mike and Ed are locked inside the surveillance room.
Danny and Ed introduce a suicidal guest (Jon Lovitz) to the thrill of gambling; Sam gets cozy with a client, then his fiancée (Paris Hilton) comes to town.
An action star (Jean-Claude Van Damme) dies while executing a stunt for his latest movie; a rival casino host squares off against Sam for the patronage of a high roller.
Ed, Danny and Sam follow a high roller to New Orleans to collect $5 million; an unruly clan of farmers gathers for a family reunion; Mike coordinates the world's largest wet T-shirt contest.

A resident (Sean Astin) wins the jackpot at a slot machine, then fakes his own death; Ed's mother (June Lockhart) regales the staff with stories of her son's childhood; a couple uses coupons to avoid spending any money in Las Vegas.

An escaped murderer seeks revenge against Sam for testifying against him; the hotel hosts a statewide cheerleading competition; Nessa discusses the merits of ⚽ [EPL] Manchester United with a trio of rowdy British soccer fans.
Stephanie and Chris thought it was a steal of a deal when they purchased their big colonial house in a great school district, so they knew it needed work.

Matt and Alicia buy their town's beloved bowling alley to save it from being torn down; but with renovations required, and only one year in hand to turn a profit, Bryan steps in to help them navigate tight finances and deadlines.

Brian and Vera build an off-grid resort of their dreams on Random Island; as they near retirement age, they realize the business is not profitable enough for them to take a step back and enjoy their golden years.
Host and DIY expert Tyler Smith brings together craftsmanship and outdoor cooking. Tyler completes backyard upgrades before cooking family-focused meals.
Fire and flavor collide as Tyler builds a fire pit set up that's ideal for everything from steaks to s'mores.
Chaney and Maureen have ideas, but need Bryan to execute them.
Sharon has strong opinions about renovating her daughter's home.
Matt and Meghan are expecting their third child so they decide to buy the big suburban house they've needed.

Erik, from Sweden, and Laura purchase a rustic cottage in rural Tennessee to settle down together, and Erik has grand visions of rebuilding it with his own bare hands, but Laura's pregnancy has forced a due date.
Darya is moving from San Francisco to Nashville to live next door to her best friend and cousin; Kortney and Kenny help bring her craftsman house up to code and make it safe for modern living.

Miriam's been sketching floor plans of the perfect place to entertain; Kortney and Kenny are eager to help make her dreams a reality; they take the reins, but with such high homeowner expectations, they're afraid of disappointing.

Huong and Jeremy hope their next real estate investment will give them quality time with their aging parents; they need Kortney and Kenny's help to renovate a bungalow in their neighborhood, so they can bring their family closer together.

Now that Miguel and Grant's family is complete, Grant wants to complete this fairy tale by making their old house feel like home; the layout and space are less than ideal, but the unseen structural issues are what Grant's reno nightmares are made of.
After a traumatic incident left Carla immobile for months, she's determined to not let another moment go by without making it worth living.
Steve's wife Pauline has trouble seeing the final vision come together. Bryan has never had to budget for indecisiveness before, which might cost the couple big in the end.
Emma and Scott have a pre-war home; Bryan teaches them the ultimate lesson.
Past problems have forced homeowners to do certain renovations.
Slowly updating their home is giving a couple headaches.
Michael and Elizabeth are living in the same childhood house Michael grew up in, so they need Kortney and Dave to help update it for modern living.
Ryan and Alisa are tired of using their bathroom as a hallway and moving like cattle through doorways, so they ask for Kortney and Dave's help to make the right reno investments to make it home.

Newlyweds Meisha and Brian have just bought their first house, but it doesn't function for them; Kortney and Dave not only have to work with a difficult layout, but with an in-law suite added to the renovation, the budget becomes almost impossible.

Ted and Shannon bought their brick bungalow sight unseen but now all they can see are its flaws; Kortney and Dave will have to open up the house and make some bold design choices before they can rebuild it.
Ian and Amber invested in a property nestled on a sprawling woodland, hoping to turn it into their first family home.
Bill and Olinka recently purchased a relic from the 60s hoping to gain a little more space for their growing toddler twins.
Josh thought he could DIY his way into a perfect home for Rita, but it's clear they need Kortney and Dave to take over if they want it all done before baby number two arrives.
Deborah and Daniel bought a house on a hill with an amazing view, but the view inside is hard to bear so now it's up to Kortney and Dave to meet their raised expectations.
A sheriff goes on the run after he is unjustly accused of murder.

After losing everything in a poker game and finding himself in debt, Lucas agrees to deliver a wagon to the town of Chamaco for a $5,000 payment. He soon finds himself in trouble with bandits, the town's local kingpin and a pretty saloon worker.
An army officer kills men under his command and robs a hundred thousand dollars in gold from a chest.
Locals want to hang a rancher (Giuliano Gemma) for stealing his own cattle and shooting a bad guy in self-defense.
A Union soldier travels to his deceased friend's home to return his belongings. He falls for his friend's sister, but the ghosts of the war return to haunt him.

Cowboys Wes (Jack Nicholson), Vern (Cameron Mitchell) and Otis (Tom Filer) are journeying through Texas when they have the unfortunate luck of meeting a gang of robbers who have just held up a stagecoach and lynched the driver. The local sheriff's posse surrounds them before they can get away, and Wes and his friends are unable to convince the lawmen they're not part of the gang. After a fierce shootout, Wes and Vern flee -- with the vigilante sheriff hot on their trail.
An Apache warrior opposes a ruthless railroad magnate's plans to carve up tribal territory for train routes.
An unjustly condemned soldier escapes and seeks justice as an outlaw.
A bank agent (Gengher Gatti) and a bandit (John Desmont) help Django (Jeff Cameron) track down the bank robbers who kidnapped his fiancée.
A man (Antonio De Teffe) joins a vicious gang of highwaymen after passing a deadly initiation. When the gang members suspect that he is a traitor, he turns on the degenerate men and seeks vengeance.

Trinity, an ex-gunslinger, desperately wants to be forgiven and accepted by his family after he abandoned them. A ruthless bounty hunter tracks Trinity down and forces him to return to face justice for his crimes.

A young half-breed is saved from death and raised as a son by his rescuer. Years later, love and betrayal tear the family apart when he falls for his adoptive sister, while a vengeful woman plots the downfall of the man who once saved them both.
A Confederate soldier turned ranger teams up with an old friend to take down a ruthless businessman.
A gunslinger returns home to make amends with his family. He soon finds himself caught up in a war between farmers and a greedy rancher.

In this Zemeckis-directed adaptation of the Carl Sagan novel, Dr. Ellie Arroway races to interpret a possible message originating from the Vega star system. Once first contact with an extraterrestrial intelligence is proven, Arroway contends with restrictive National Security Advisor Kitz and religious fanatics bent on containing the implications of such an event. An incredible message is found hidden in the signal, but will Arroway be the one to answer its call?

Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable.

Young Peter is plagued by a noise from inside his bedroom wall, a tapping that his parents insist is in his imagination. As his fear intensifies, he starts to believe that his parents are hiding a secret.
An English teacher (Meg Ryan) has an affair with a detective (Mark Ruffalo), though she suspects him of murdering a woman.

Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.
A successful writer (Greg Kinnear) tries to reconnect with his two children (Lily Collins, Nat Wolff) after his divorce.

Charlie (Michael Douglas) gets released from an insane asylum and moves in with Miranda (Evan Rachel Wood), the young daughter he left behind. Charlie believes that there is treasure hidden beneath the local Costco, so he puts together a plan to unearth the loot. By convincing Miranda to quit her job at McDonald's and instead work at the wholesale store, he is able to obtain a key. Although Miranda is skeptical, she helps her father with his irrational quest.
Two New York film editors attempt to hold on to their significant others while working on a film in crisis.
A teen (Asa Butterfield), a pregnant girl (Hailee Steinfeld) and the lead singer (Emile Hirsch) of a punk-rock band form their own surrogate family in late-1980s New York.

On the way to a tryout with the ⚾🐻 [MLB] Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

After making a speech in Moscow vowing to never negotiate with terrorists, President James Marshall boards Air Force One with his family and advisers. When a group of terrorists led by Ivan Korshunov hijacks the flight, the President's principles are put to the test. Feigning escape, ex-soldier Marshall stows away in the aircraft and must race against time to rescue his family and everyone else on board.
A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab.

Terence McDonagh isn't doing so well. He has a nasty painkiller addiction, courtesy of an injury he sustained while rescuing a prisoner during Hurricane Katrina. Plus, there's his alcoholic father, boozy wife, and prostitute girlfriend. And, he's just been saddled with a rookie partner. Now Terence must pull himself back from the edge of insanity to investigate a series of murders that has the city on edge.

As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.
A young woman must foil the terrorist who killed her parents before he strikes again on the island of Nantucket.
A retired veteran hunting in Allagash, Maine, discovers a dead woman with a duffel bag full of money. He soon finds himself in a web of deceit and murder.
A former agent (Aaron Eckhart) of the CIA and his estranged daughter (Liana Liberato) go on the run after his employers target them for assassination.

When his young children are abducted by his old nemesis, Capt. Hook (Dustin Hoffman) middle-aged lawyer Peter Banning (Robin Williams) returns to his magical origins as Peter Pan. Peter must revisit a foggy past in which he abandoned Neverland for family life, leaving Tinkerbell (Julia Roberts) and the Lost Boys to fend for themselves. Given their bitterness toward Peter for growing up -- and their allegiance to their new leader, Rufio -- the old gang may not be happy to see him.

Peasant-born William Thatcher (Heath Ledger) begins a quest to change his stars, win the heart of an exceedingly fair maiden (Shanynn Sossamon) and rock his medieval world. With the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), he faces the ultimate test of medieval gallantry -- tournament jousting -- and tries to discover if he has the mettle to become a legend.
Movie, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Romance, Historical drama

Gracie Hart (Sandra Bullock) was never thrilled to have to go undercover as a competitor in a beauty pageant. Now Gracie, who works for the FBI, is dealing with some very public attention thanks to her waltz down the runway. Her overnight celebrity does not impress her new partner, Sam Fuller (Regina King). But the pair has to put aside their differences when one of Gracie's former beauty queen pals, Cheryl Frasier (Heather Burns), turns up missing, and the FBI is put on the case.

After ruining their friend's wedding gown, bridesmaids (Kirsten Dunst, Isla Fisher, Lizzy Caplan) set out on a frantic search for a replacement, but their mission degenerates into a night of booze, drugs and nightclubbing.

When Lindsay gets the chance to sign up to the notoriously exclusive dating service Eternity, she clashes with Will, her first date. They mutually agree that the dating service is a complete bust and make a deal to get their money back.

After drag racing his vintage convertible around Palm Springs, Calif., a retired NASA test pilot loses his license. Forced to take public transportation, he meets Caroline and learns to navigate love and life again.
At her sister's wedding, a food critic meets a chef known for excluding food reviewers entry to his restaurant and must find a way to reconcile their differences.

Alison remains anonymous while critiquing restaurants, but when she accidentally goes viral for trashing a new restaurant, her editor insists she make amends by going undercover as a prep cook for the chef she maligned.
Sparks fly between a talented chef and her childhood best friend as she regains her passion for cooking.
Carrie is convinced that she has met the man of her dreams at her sister's wedding, so she decides to contact an expert in romantic relationships online.
When hard-working content creator Jenny goes on a retreat searching for a proper work/life balance, she ends up finding love as well.
Sparks fly between an uptight lawyer and an indebted lodge owner as she tries to get him to sell it to her boss's cousin.
A workaholic lawyer returns to her island home to convince an old friend to take over his family's company, but rekindled feelings soon get in the way.

In the wake of their friends' marriages and eventual offspring, longtime pals Julie (Jennifer Westfeldt) and Jason (Adam Scott) decide to have a child together without becoming a couple. By becoming "time-share" parents, they reason, they can experience the joys of parenthood without significantly curbing their personal freedom. However, when Julie and Jason both become involved with others, they discover that they secretly harbor romantic feelings for each other.

Lisa Jorgenson's (Reese Witherspoon) entire life has been defined by softball, but at 31, she is deemed too old to play and cut from the team. After being cast adrift, she begins a fling with Matty (Owen Wilson), a charming womanizer who plays professional baseball. About the same time, she goes on a blind date with George (Paul Rudd), a businessman on the hook for stock fraud. Caught in a romantic triangle with the two men, Lisa ponders the meaning of love.

Hazel Grace Lancaster, a 16-year-old cancer patient, meets and falls in love with Gus Waters, a similarly afflicted teen from her cancer support group. Hazel feels that Gus really understands her. They both share the same acerbic wit and a love of books, especially Grace's touchstone, "An Imperial Affliction" by Peter Van Houten. When Gus scores an invitation to meet the reclusive author, he and Hazel embark on the adventure of their brief lives.

A fleet of Martian spacecraft surrounds the world's major cities and all of humanity waits to see if the extraterrestrial visitors have, as they claim, "come in peace." U.S. President James Dale (Jack Nicholson) receives assurance from science professor Donald Kessler (Pierce Brosnan) that the Martians' mission is a friendly one. But when a peaceful exchange ends in the total annihilation of the U.S. Congress, military men call for a full-scale nuclear retaliation.

In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.
Movie, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Drama

After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.
Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home.

Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

Lillian says she found out online that her fiancé, Yahdaiyah, had a baby with another woman; he says Lillian also cheated on him, and he suspects she's still seeing her ex; she is fed up with his bad temper and controlling ways.

Clyde and Wendell are ready to get married, but have been keeping their relationship a secret from Clyde's best friend and roommate Antonio, who just happens to be Wendell's ex; now that they all [LIVE] under the same roof, tensions are running high.

John says wife Melissa got an abortion without discussing it with him, then took off with a married man; she says she cheated because John won't let go of the past; her health problems and his lack of trust have left their sex life in dire straits.
Lonequa fears fiancé Eulis is cheating on her after finding messages he sent to another woman on his phone.
Bryan says he recently went through his husband's phone and found out he was planning a group sex session.
Erika was married when she met Harold, and the pair formed a special bond; when Erika's husband walked out on Christmas Day, Harold moved in.
Jacob gave up the son he had with another woman to save his marriage to Ashley, but it hasn't ended the trouble at home; Ashley claims Jacob cheats and puts down her dreams of being an actress.
After spending time in prison, Curtis is a free man again, but he says his wife, Lolinda, won't let him have a relationship with his family and friends.
Tyesha claims her boyfriend, Charles, is a cheater and an immature mama's boy; Charles says Tyesha is the one behaving badly, and she needs to stop criticizing his close relationship with his mom.
Laurie and Joseph met at an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting 17 years ago; Laurie remains devoted to AA, but Joseph no longer attends meetings and suffered a relapse since they've been married.

Carfricia says Carl's resentment over giving up his rap career to take care of their family fuels his anger and verbal abuse; she also disagrees with his view that Earth is flat and wants him to stop promoting his theories online.
Shanique claims Rasaan is a liar and a cheat who can't be trusted; Rasaan says Shanique has a toxic attitude, and it's poisoning their relationship.

Nathan can't get over wife Kendall cheating on him with a man she met online; Kendall says Nathan's mother is a big source of their problems, and they need to move out of her home and find their own place.
Davetta was diagnosed with HIV a month after she and Jermaine tied the knot, sending her into a deep depression; she says he cheated on her repeatedly and she got revenge by sleeping with other men.

Davetta and Jermaine are dealing with an HIV diagnosis and have two children together; he has admitted to sleeping with nine different women during their eight-year marriage, while she has cheated twice, including with his childhood friend.

Heather and Rodney have a 10-year age difference and moved in together after dating for only 10 days; 20-year-old Heather wants a fairy-tale wedding, but Rodney says she still has some growing up to do, and he's not ready to commit.
Tapeka, who is legally blind, thinks her partner, Stacy, is stealing from her and no longer trusts him; Stacy wants Tapeka to stop the accusations and treat him like her man, not the hired help.

Christina and Bobby fight over money, raising the kids and infidelity; they are behind on rent and can barely pay their bills and, to make matters worse, she says, he destroys their belongings when he gets upset.

Jeffery says Jennifer needs to stop flirting with other men and look for a full-time job to help support their baby; Jennifer says Jeffery's jealousy is hurting their relationship and accuses him of talking to other women.
Greg wants to start a family, but Brittany doesn't want children; he also complains that he's the only one cleaning up after the couple's 15 pets while working multiple jobs.
Best friends Janelle and Cecily dumped their boyfriends and decided to have a same-sex relationship; the BFFs-turned-spouses are struggling to get along just two months after their wedding.
Trae's brother's murder plunged Trae into a deep depression; wife Elneta says he doesn't communicate with her and has stopped being the family man he once was.

Raul says Crystal is involved in porn, but he can't prove it; she is tired of him constantly accusing her of cheating and things that aren't true, and believes he's punishing her for leaving him twice during their 13-year relationship.
Aaron says girlfriend Kaylin is the woman of his dreams, and he wants to settle down and have a family; Kaylin doesn't want any more children and is fed up with Aaron's clingy and overbearing ways.

Raphael and Kirsten decided to have an open relationship after he cheated on her with three women, but he is having second thoughts now that the tables have turned, and she is doing more of the dating.

Samara gave up her career to let husband Marquis be the man of the house but says his bad financial decisions are hurting their bottom line; now, the father of four wants to quit his job to become an actor and model.
Lucille is ready to kick Tony to the curb if he doesn't start bringing in more money; he admits he's not much of a breadwinner, but says she needs to stop flirting with other men to get back at him.
Kurt and Kimberly married to help keep her out of prison, and now she says she's sexually attracted to women.

Robin says husband Blake spends money on trips with his family and friends but won't take her out for her birthday or celebrate their anniversary; Blake says Robin needs to contribute more to the household and step it up in the bedroom.

Sandra thought Damon was her knight in shining armor with no children, but she found out he had nine kids with eight women; she also says he has a drinking problem, and she won't marry him until he gets it under control.
Mercedes says Jonathan treats her more like a business partner than a wife and the mother of his child; she believes he's keeping secrets and cheating on her.

Porsha says fiancé Parish didn't support her emotionally after a series of miscarriages, and he has anger issues, especially when he drinks; now that she's pregnant again, she wants him to get his temper under control and help pay the bills.

Rikki and Becky met in prison as inmates and struggles with sobriety have plagued their relationship from the start; Rikki says Becky is unfaithful when they're apart; Becky claims Rikki can't be trusted and cheated on her with an ex-boyfriend.

DeShawn suspects husband Derick is messing around behind her back, and she's ready to call it quits; Derick admits to flirting with other women, but denies having an affair and says DeShawn is the one who cheated on him.

Wendy says she no longer loves husband Richard and their son is the only reason they're still together; after losing thousands of dollars on Richard's failed business ventures, Wendy is ready to move on.

V discovered husband Terry was having a relationship with another woman the day before their wedding, and a week later she found out that woman was pregnant; within six months, another woman was also pregnant by Terry.
A major age gap isn't the only problem plaguing Khmari and Tyrone's marriage -- they both have addiction issues; Khmari got sober after the birth of their baby, but says Tyrone won't stop drinking.
Kelsey and Steven's May/December romance has gone off the rails -- Steven is tired of people thinking they're father and daughter, and he no longer trusts Kelsey after she cheated on him with her ex.

Ezell says Laticia is a mean drunk, and he wants her to clean up her act; Laticia says Ezell doesn't take care of her in the manner to which she is accustomed, and she's sick of him running away every time they argue.
High school sweethearts Tyler and Alex have two kids, but Alex has doubts he's the father of the older child -- he says Tyler dated someone else during a breakup, and her ex may be the dad.

Bartley and Britney have different parenting styles, and it's creating a rift in their relationship; Britney says Bartley is too strict and punishes the kids for small things, and now that Bartley is out of work, their arguments have gotten worse.
Randal is pregnant and wants William to get a full-time job and stop playing video games all day; William says Randal is overbearing and won't stop calling him names.
Billie says Bianca is sneaky and refuses to answer her phone on speaker; Bianca says Billie is paranoid, and he's the one doing the cheating.

Venetta wants Maceo to stop talking to other women online and start saving money to buy her a ring; Maceo says Venetta needs to start trusting him and stop being so mean; they are also at odds over how to discipline the children.

Tyresha and Usif have been together for 11 years but don't have children due to infertility issues; she says she caught him cheating online, but he says her infertility makes her insecure, fueling mistrust and arguments.

Maria can no longer stand Donnie's excessive drinking and verbal abuse and has already moved on to another boyfriend, whom she says Donnie has been harassing; Donnie says Maria is a low-life, and he's worked hard to provide for her and their baby.
Wedding vows haven't stopped Jonathan from flirting with other women, but he blames Crystal for not giving him enough attention.
David wants Sara to stop ogling other guys and get a job; she says he needs to trust her and get past his jealousy.

Tabatha's promiscuous past causes her husband, Thomas, to watch her every move; the couple's threesomes are creating even more problems, and, to make matters worse, Tabatha believes Thomas is using drugs again.
Desmond cheated on Khadine after they lost their 1-month-old baby, so they separated, but now he is fighting to get her back.
Joseph says his wife is a serial cheater, and he's not sure their newborn is really his; Shadow admits she's cheated, but maintains the baby is Joseph's.
Yaminah experienced postpartum depression and says Tremaine wasn't there for her when she needed him; Tremaine blames a violent upbringing for his communication problems.

Letress says Terrance ditched her for the strip club when she was seven months pregnant, then didn't support her after a miscarriage; Terrance calls Letress insecure and says her bad temper is pushing him away.

Karen and Nana met at a gas station, and it wasn't long before Karen was snooping through Nana's stuff and following him; she later caught him creeping out of his ex-wife's apartment complex, and he may be hiding someone else.

Avantiese says he can't trust Danielle ever since she cheated on him; Danielle says she and Avantiese have a sexless marriage; she's sick of driving him around because he doesn't have a license and can't keep a job.

No matter how hard Demont tries, he's always looking up at the bar Reasha keeps raising, and the romance took a hard turn into a wall when Demont got a promotion and relocated for work, which raised her suspicions of him cheating.

La'Tanya is honest with Jonathan about her sexual attraction to women, which gives him serious concerns about going forward, and the final straw was when her kids came home singing "Jonathan is a bad daddy," even though he supports the family.
Harriet is fed up with her husband's drinking and unwillingness to get a job; Terry says he's happy being a stay-at-home dad and his drinking isn't a problem, despite several DUIs.
Corey has cheated on his wife with 27 women but wants a divorce because she had one affair, and he no longer trusts her.
Jasmine says she uncovered a web of lies while going through Jason's computer; he even went on a cruise without her; but despite the cheating, she still wants a committed relationship.
Isla and Antonio's marriage hasn't been the same since Isla had a miscarriage; she says Antonio didn't give her the support she needed and doesn't contribute enough to the household.
Terijo says Jonay is so controlling, she can't leave the house without his permission; Jonay claims Terijo is a liar and pays too much attention to her ex.

Erin feels like Timothy doesn't care about the relationship, and she's considering moving on; he is tired of being kicked out of the house every time she catches an attitude; she dropped out of college and left behind a scholarship because of him.
Brittany and Shaheed have been dating for two years and have a baby boy together; Brittany says Shaheed isn't fulfilling his fatherly duties and all they do is argue.
