A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.
An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.
Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.
A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.
A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.
Two gangsters try to use Herman to swindle insurance companies.
Herman is given a tryout by Leo Durocher after his mighty drive sends a baseball sailing out of the ballpark.
Herman is convinced that a television competition is fixed, until he wins free membership at an exclusive country club.
Marilyn decides to elope with a bank employee who is interested in the Munsters' money.
Herman is mistaken for a perfectly preserved mummy.
Eddie volunteers to have Herman perform in a school talent show.
Herman buys a piece of land as a vacation home for the family, which he discovers in a prospectus; the fraudsters who originally sold the property have received a better offer and want it back.
Herman drag-races in the family hearse to back up Eddie's boast that his dad is a better driver than his friend's father.
When Herman is forced to work overtime at the parlor, Lily grows furious and convinces him that he deserves a raise; he is fired when he demands an increase in pay.
Herman rescues a little boy whose head is trapped in the park railings, but doesn't get all the credit he deserves; Herman strikes up a friendship with the youngster.
Herman causes a major crisis when he chastises Spot for tracking mud into the house.
Eddie runs away when one of his friends convinces him that all parents are mean.

Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

After decades of living on the run, murder suspect Frank O'Neal (Billy Burke) returns to Los Angeles hoping to put his derailed existence back on track. O'Neal reconnects with an old flame, Karen Mellor (Sherry Stringfield), and finds gainful employment as a driver for an armored truck service. But, as he falls under the influence of a maniacal televangelist (Gregory Itzin), the unsavory impulses behind O'Neal's return begin to surface, threatening to destroy him.

New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.
El destino los une otra vez, "La Felina" no puede creer lo que ve con sus propios ojos y sin perder un segundo coloca dos toneladas de droga, una conexión directa entre México y Venezuela.
En el funeral de Luz Marina Casillas, Aurelio jura venganza por las mujeres que marcaron su vida. El responsable de la muerte de su hija y de su madre la va a pagar. Alex no es quien dice ser.
A solas, Mecha y Casillas se preguntan quién es quién, él se entera de qué perfil de hombre desea ella. Con un bisturí él se corta el área donde tiene el chip insertado, Mecha se lo extrae.
La mayor motivación de Aurelio es reunirse con su familia y hace todo lo posible para lograrlo. Tracy Lobo debe demostrar que puede detener a Casillas, su ascenso está en juego.
Una persecución sin frenos desata una balacera entre la DEA y Aurelio Casillas. En el camino, Mecha lo ayuda sin saber quién es él, las descargas lo aturden. Aguirre reporta una baja.
Mecha esconde a Aurelio en un túnel y el coqueteo surge de la nada. Lucas Manzano le da un ultimátum a Tracy Lobo: si no atrapa a Casillas a la medianoche, debe finalizar el operativo.
El olfato de Tracy Lobo apunta a la fábrica de hielo donde está el escondite de Casillas, mientras él está abrumado por los recuerdos. Detienen al "Pollo" y da un falso testimonio.
Cuando los Casillas van a darle el último adiós a Doña Alba y "El Pulque", les tienden una trampa, atrás quedan las balas, el fentanilo es protagonista.
Aurelio confirma la muerte de su madre y se entera de que Luzma está grave. "Uña de tigre" le cuenta sobre el intento de asesinato múltiple en el funeral de Doña Alba, "Pío" lideró el ataque.
Aurelio Casillas es el Señor de los Cielos, va y viene del más allá cuando quiere y planta cara ante sus aliados. Don Julio daba por desaparecida a "La Soberana", ahora le da la bienvenida.
Llenas de incredulidad, las especulaciones brotan por todos lados y a Ismael le toca la peor parte, recibe una visita que lo conmueve y lo enfurece. La orden de un juez llega al hospital.
Corina descubre el proyecto secreto con el que se fabricó la supuesta muerte de Aurelio Casillas, llamado "Código Lázaro". Ismael sorprende a Rutila, quien confundida reclama y se conmueve.
El video de vigilancia del hospital es una prueba de vida de Aurelio Casillas para Alfaro, pero a Manzano y a Colón no les convence. Corina confiesa su amor por el Señor de los Cielos.
Las sospechas señalan a Corina Saldaña como la infiltrada, su puesto en la DEA pende de un hilo. Aurelio Casillas se acerca a ella para saber si es cómplice de la estrategia de enterrarlo vivo.
Jaime piensa en la forma de eliminar todo lo que haya en la memoria de Berenice, tal vez provocar un suicidio lanzándola por el balcón. Diana está muy preocupada por ella.
Aurelio le propone a Diana que se entregue a las autoridades de Estados Unidos y aunque al principio parece una broma, ella tiene que confiar en él, todo está coordinado con Corina.
Tracy Lobo tiene el poder y su intención es usarlo en contra de Mecha, haberla desafiado le va a costar caro. Rutila enfurece con la idea de entregar a Diana a la DEA, es demasiado el riesgo.
Caridad se siente atraída por Aurelio y "La Felina" le da un buen consejo, pero ella no la escucha. Carla y Corina comparten información confidencial. Jaime exige "desconectar" a Bere.
Aurelio paga la fianza de Mecha y, al salir, ella no puede parar de hacerle preguntas, pero la prioridad es saber quién es él. Se muerde los labios, ella está tentada a decirle la verdad.
Zambrana ya ha esperado demasiado y exige a Fernando que atente contra la vida de Ismael, es hora de liquidarlo. "Vitaminas" identifica a Tracy Lobo, espera la orden de Casillas para disparar.
Antes de enfrentar a los atacantes de Ismael, Aurelio le pide a Corina que lo acompañe, aunque no les conviene que los vean juntos. "La Felina" se une a los Casillas con armas y hombres.
Aurelio reúne a la familia y ordena mantenerse alertas, después de la masacre. Rutila le hace una advertencia a su padre que no tiene vuelta atrás. Casillas ya sabe cómo rescatar a Bere.
Diana, aún consciente de provocar un disgusto, le pone a Aurelio Casillas una condición de último minuto antes de entregarse a la DEA. Roberta le confiesa a Mecha su atracción por las mujeres.
Casillas le ordena al gobernador, Jaime Rosales, parar el operativo de la DEA e impedir la extradición de Diana. La detenida recibe una oferta de Alfaro que implica una traición sin medida.
Una banda de criminales busca a Mecha para borrarla del mapa, al enterarse de que es ella quien ayuda a los migrantes a huir. "Vitaminas" le informa a Casillas que su mujer está bajo amenaza.
Corina roba información, tiene una pista que es clave para Aurelio y sus deseos de venganza; él no deja de pensar en Mecha, cree que ella es la indicada, tiene en mente viajar a Mexicali.
Las cosas van demasiado lejos, Corina sufre por Aurelio, pero lo prometido es deuda. Fernando allana el terreno con Rutila, va de frente y una rosa roja le arranca una sonrisa al día siguiente.
Clarissa Molina habla sin filtros de su historia con el humor que la caracteriza. También hay confesiones, entrevistas, consejos y mucha diversión.

Jung y Lehder planeaban encontrarse, pero Lewis arresta a Jung. Lehder huye y se asocia con la policía de las Bahamas. Nava, un nuevo policía de la O.I.A, encubre a Lehder a cambio de su aporte a la causa.

El caso de Mia da un giro inesperado, por lo que Maya y Samuel comienzan una investigación por diversos puntos de la ciudad. Pau y los chicos tratan de lidiar con la ausencia de Mia. Greg recibe un mensaje fuera de lo común.

Idoia e Itzi intentan resolver sus diferencias con el objetivo de tener su propio frontón; la pieza clave para conseguirlo es el marido de Ane. Rosa, otra de las pelotaris mexicanas, acompaña a Chelo en su recuperación.
Elena Rose abre su corazón y habla sobre el proceso detrás de su nuevo álbum.
Silvestre Dangond hace un recorrido íntimo por más de 20 años de trayectoria artística.

Dos generaciones de poder femenino hablan con "la Chama": Lola Índigo y Olga Tañón. Lola se abre sobre las críticas que ha enfrentado en su carrera y Olga comparte un lado más íntimo hablando de la familia y su nueva producción musical.
Vicky "la Chama" Van entrevista a grandes invitados y artistas, quienes comparten cómo es la vida tras la música.
Una niña es adoptada por un regimiento militar y educada como varón, cuando ella se enamora creen que es un marica.
Luis y Frankie aceptan una apuesta contra los vecinos del otro edificio para probar quiénes son mejores jugando tenis de mesa. Luis se lastima la mano y Pedro tiene que jugar en su lugar.

Luis y Don Roque deciden participar en un maratón; Germán daña una tubería y los vecinos deben pagar una multa; Luis acepta pagar la infracción si gana el maratón, pero se cae justo antes de llegar a la meta.
Vítor y Albertano deciden compartir la tradición de los Reyes Magos con los niños y ganar dinero para poder sobrevivir, al final la magia los sorprenderá.
Albertano y Vítor trabajan en una pizzería, mientras que doña Cuca y don Nacho piensan que Lupita está embarazada.
Aparecen ante la familia quienes dicen ser los verdaderos padres de Justito. Plácido cuenta cómo se hizo mejor amigo de su jefa millennial.
Una supervisora visita la casa de los López para saber si la Nena aspira a una plaza como maestra. Para pasar la revisión, la familia debe fingir que son otras personas.
Un joven se la pasa en las calles metiéndose en problemas todo el tiempo. El joven decide cambiar y comienza a trabajar para ser una mejor persona.
Una joven conoce al chico más popular de la escuela. El joven resulta ser miembro de una banda de secuestradores de chicas.

Mariana descubre que su hija ha sido abusada en la guardería donde la lleva. Sin embargo, la directora intenta sobornar al juez encargado del caso para que no siga investigando. ¿Mariana podrá hacer justicia por su hija?

Esperanza pierde a su hija Tania y la busca por toda la ciudad. Después de dos años, Esperanza coincide con Mayra, una niña que fue separada de su madre, y decide cuidarla. ¿Esperanza olvidará a Tania o continuará con su búsqueda?

Desde el corazón de Medellín, Maluma abre las puertas de su mundo como nunca antes. En una conversación íntima con la influencer global Lola Lolita, el artista recorre los lugares que marcaron su historia y comparte recuerdos personales.

Esmeralda le dice a Josefina que es novia de Dimitrio y ella sufre al pensar que él solo juega con sus sentimientos. Alejandro le confiesa a Montserrat que José Luis está muerto, ella se pone muy mal con la noticia y cree que es su culpa.

Alejandro se molesta con María por la manera en que trata a los empleados de la hacienda y le exige respetarlos. Josefina le confiesa a Graciela que está enamorada de Dimitrio, pero ella la humilla y le deja en claro que no le agrada.
Aída trata de convencer a Mariano que Teresa le envío los papeles de divorcio para arruinarle la vida. Luisa decide que Fernando sea el primer hombre en su vida.
Juana descubre que Teresa usará otro vestido de novia y no el que ella le hizo. Mayra le pide ayuda a Arturo para divorciarse de Rubén. Aída decide conquistar a Mariano para vengarse de Teresa.
Viridiana le dice a la policía que Soledad renunció y Cecilia la ayuda a esconderse, pero logran detenerla. Remedios le cuenta a Ana Lucía que Santiago se está muriendo.
Raquel busca a Isabel y le exige que se aleje de Jorge. Joaquín les confiesa a Mónica y sus amigas que su padre es el dueño del instituto.
Elisa le cuenta a Lolita que planea casarse con Gael. Elisa teme que Paloma deje de ser su amiga al saber sobre su boda.

Leona sigue a Ramsés al lugar donde están las porristas y graba todo. Leona por poco es descubierta, pero logra escapar. Gael va a casa de Leona y le da un beso. Leona le confiesa a David que Gael la besó.

Ana Laura deja de tener miedo y tiene relaciones con Ramiro por primera vez. Ana Leticia e Iñaki se deshacen del cuerpo de Isidro y Orlando los graba. Ana Leticia va a buscar a Ana Lucía a la pensión y la encuentra abrazada de Mariano.
Isabel y sus amigas le exigen a Raquel alejarse de Jorge; ella les asegura que no dejará de luchar por él. Isabel le reclama a su padre por contarle a Carmen que tiene problemas con el alcohol.

Paloma se sorprende al ver a Elisa y Gael besándose. Damián llega a un acuerdo con su madre para proteger a Elisa. Damián acepta casarse con Florencia a cambio de que Alfonsina le devuelva a Elisa sus tierras.

David le revela a Camila que sí es candidata para una operación de médula espinal. Ramsés le pide a Josefa renovar sus votos matrimoniales. Jeremías le confiesa a Lola que Benjamín no es su hermano de sangre.
Montserrat se desmaya al ver a José Luis en la hacienda de Alejandro. María le dice a Alejandro que Montserrat nunca lo amará porque no es como ellos.
En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.
Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.
Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.
Marcia se disculpa con Fernando y le promete dejar de insistir en el tema de Lety. Por otra parte, Lety le comparte a Tomás lo que aprendió con Aldo.
Celso no deja a Lety entrar a Conceptos; Paula María se molesta al enterarse de que Simón llevó a Alicia a su casa en la motocicleta; Lola se niega a conciliar con Efrén por la presencia de Jazmín.
Teresita le pide a Marcia que se presente en la sala de juntas; las del cuartel comentan la reacción de Marcia al ver a Lety.
Aldo sigue a Lety hasta un autobús y se sube detrás de ella; Fernando se encuentra al vidente en un restaurante y recibe premoniciones sobre Lety y Marcia.
El licenciado Sánchez acepta darle seguimiento al divorcio de Lola; Alicia le coquetea al licenciado Santa María, pero no logra salir con él porque Rosales insiste en salir con ella.
Omar le aconseja a Fernando reconquistar a Lety para que no se queden en la calle; Alicia se porta muy raro con Leticia, quien le pide a Marcia poner en claro su relación laboral.
Luigi les cuenta a Carolina y Aldo por qué don Humberto nombró a Lety presidenta de Conceptos; Lety nombra a Tomás vicepresidente financiero de la empresa.
Fernando y Simón llegan al bar donde están las del cuartel; Simón hace corajes porque Paula María baila con otro y Fernando se molesta porque hay un hombre junto a Leticia.
Lety le dice a Tomás que les contó a las del cuartel que ya no son novios; el juez concede a Conceptos seis meses para liquidar su adeudo a Filmo Imagen antes de entrar a remate.
Luigi presenta a Aldo con Marcia y le dice que trabajará con él en un proyecto ajeno a Conceptos; Alicia ofende a los pasajeros del autobús antes de bajar.

Raúl instala a Tomás en la antigua oficina de Olarte y, al ver a Alicia hablar con Aldo, piensa que hay algo entre ellos; Lety toma su lugar en la que fue oficina de Fernando; Aldo y Fernando se conocen.
Leti le pide a Alicia que cite a Marcia en la sala de juntas y Alicia aprovecha la oportunidad para meter cizaña.
Marcia le ordena a Luigi presentarse en la junta; Lety informa al consejo sobre las concesiones que dictó el juez y propone el proyecto que pensó con Aldo para reunir el dinero.
Luigi anuncia que renunciará a Conceptos al terminar la inauguración de la feria gastronómica y pide que contraten a Jazmín.
Alicia le expresa a Marcia su desacuerdo sobre ser su secretaria; Marcia le pide su renuncia y Alicia se retracta; Aldo le pide a Fernando hablar a solas para conocerse.
Lety presenta a Tomás con Aldo; Tomás le dice a Lety que Aldo no le cae muy bien porque Alicia quiere con él.

Marcia le dice a Alicia que está segura de que Lety y Fernando van a verse porque él la apoyó en todo durante la junta; Lety le dice a Tomás que no pudo tirar los regalos de Fernando y por eso se los regresó.
Aldo le dice a Carolina que el regalo que le compró a Lety no es para conquistarla, pues él la conquistará con el corazón.
Lety le dice a Aldo que ya no quiere hablar de Fernando y recordar todo lo que sufrió; Marcia sorprende a las del cuartel hablando sobre ella en el baño.
Simón le dice a Paula María que su relación seguirá congelada hasta que ella compruebe que no tiene nada que ver con el hombre con el que la encontró bailando.
Aldo le aclara a Ariel por qué eligió Conceptos para la promoción. Ariel percibe un mal olor en Fernando, pero él lo niega. Fernando le confiesa a Omar qué es lo que buscaba en la basura.
Tomás defiende a Alicia de los insultos de Ariel; las del cuartel le piden a Sara hacerle caso al licenciado Sánchez para que mejore su actitud con Lola.
El licenciado Sánchez invita a Sara a bailar y ella se niega a pesar de las insistencias de Lola; Alicia siente que Aldo quiere molestarla porque la llevó a comer tostadas de pata.
Lety le confiesa a Aldo que soñó con Fernando y lo invita a desayunar; Aldo se da cuenta de que perdió la perla que guardó en su saco; Don Erasmo le reclama a Lety por salir tan temprano de la casa.
Fernando y Omar se burlan de la exposición de Aldo; los gerentes aceptan el proyecto gracias a Aldo y Fernando; las del cuartel le muestran a Lety la carta que encontraron.
Alicia se burla de Tomás porque quiere parecerse a Aldo; Tom le agradece a Aldo que lo haya rescatado por segunda vez y le ofrece su amistad.
Matt aids Tilly the cow's birth at a local cattle farm; Mike and Rebecca's amorous pony needs Peter's attention; Julian performs surgery on a girl's ailing guinea pig.
Peter treats a lamb with a leg infection; Julian deals with a mysterious lump on a llama called Imposter; a greyhound with a crushed ankle receives an implant.
Matt delivers a calf, Peter removes a lump from a dog's eye, and Julian repairs a slipped patella on a cat and nips a sheep with a birth defect; Peter and Shona go 4-wheeling.

Star, a three-legged sheep, might be given a new lease of life if Matt can fit her with a prosthetic leg; Julian meets Teddy, a 10-month-old dachshund and his owner Kerry, who believes Teddy saved her life when she went into cardiac arrest.

Matt responds to an urgent call from a 16-year-old farmer who's worried about his pregnant ewe; Peter takes Hannah to meet Cyril, a huge bull that needs a pedicure and does not seem at all keen on the idea.

Peter rushes a pregnant husky into surgery, hoping he can deliver live puppies but fears he may be too late to save them all; a lamb with a badly broken leg arrives at the Thirsk practice; Matt treats Matilda, a very poorly cow.

Peter heads up Sutton Bank for a lambing with a view; however, there's no time to admire the surroundings because a lamb is stuck, and it is too late for a C-section; Julian meets a pug with an unusual name and an unusual problem.

Peter tackles the most overgrown tortoise beak he's ever seen; Julian treats a Vizsla puppy that's eaten a washing up sponge for the second time; David attends a ewe who has suffered a life-threatening prolapse; a donkey finds a new home.

Mangalitsa pig breeder Lisa is worried about her boar Hal, who has a large lump on his neck; a famous client brings their dog to the practice; Matt is in uncharted waters as he heads to a local college to operate on one of their fish.

Peter has an emergency at the practice in Kirkbymoorside, when a local farming couple rush in their pregnant Texel ewe; Julian operates on a terrier suffering with bladder stones; Peter visits the Green's farm to see a lonely donkey.

Peter rushes to help a pregnant cow that is expecting twins, which is uncommon; Julian meets a champion ferret who has an infected foot; Shona heads out to see an old horse that is suffering with sore eyes.

When a baby alpaca's life hangs in the balance, Julian performs an emergency blood plasma transfusion on the front lawn of the Thirsk practice; Peter meets a cat with an unusual backstory, but who now has a serious eye problem.

Peter battles to deliver lambs who are jumbled up and stuck inside their mum, and he is shocked by what he finds; Julian has to contend with an angry parrot that has escaped in the surgery; a rescue dog is attacked by another dog.
A rare-breed pony is in danger when she suffers a prolapsed uterus soon after giving birth.
Julian visits house pig Pigley Scott, who has had a horse tread on his trotter; father and son farmers are worried about Roger, their prize bull, who has a large lump on his neck that may be a tumor.

Julian rushes Walter the shih tzu into surgery after the dog has broken its jaw in a freak accident; Peter operates on a horse called Sammy; Matt needs to take drastic action to help a dairy cow; Shona and Matt meet the vets of tomorrow.

Julian is reunited with an alpaca he delivered by C-section when she develops a mystery eye problem; a heavily pregnant ewe is rushed into the Huddersfield hospital; Peter examines his brother's terrier; Matt treats three marmosets.
Peter faces a scare aiding a horse with cancerous growths; Julian meets a cockapoo with a broken leg; Matt operates on a cow's tail; Shona enters a showjumping competition.

A lamb is rushed to the Huddersfield hospital with a ruptured eye; he needs surgery, but Matt's worried there might be a problem with the lamb's other eye; Peter operates on a Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Julian castrates a miniature pony.
Peter heads to an old friend's farm on his day off to help with a tough lambing; Julian meets a European polecat called Poldark; Staff treat a French bulldog puppy requiring complex surgery.
Julian urgently gathers extra hands for a Great Dane's cesarean; young vet Matt joyfully weds Katherine, surrounded by veterinary friends and heartfelt celebrations.
As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger; Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog, Reuben, who is couch-bound with arthritis.

Julian operates on a French Bulldog that has injured one of his three legs; Matt Smith rushes to a farm to try and save a ewe and her unborn lamb; Peter and Shona have some donkey work to do at the Greens' farm.

Matt Smith heads to Cannon Hall Farm where Rob and Dave's latest arrival, a Highland calf, has serious breathing problems; Rohin Aojula takes his dad on a call to help a horse that has suffered a nasty injury while out riding.

Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with flystrike, resulting in maggots living in its ear; the Huddersfield team performs spinal surgery on a French Bulldog; Julian Norton meets pet pig Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.

Peter treats two wild owls brought into his practice; Shona rushes to the aid of a horse that has trodden on a nail; Julian has to learn sign language in order to communicate with a deaf dachshund that requires surgery.

Matt and David meet Jon Bon Pony; Peter treats a farmer's Labrador who's struggling to walk after cutting herself on a nail; Julian operates on a chicken with an infected leg; Robin aids a pregnant ewe.
Two pet goats have been attacked by an unknown animal; Peter visits an old friend's farm to help a pig; a dog has eaten children's vitamin pills.

Peter Wright treats two kittens that have been dumped in a bag and set on fire; Shona performs an emergency cesarean to try and save a cow and her calf; Julian hopes to help a dog suffering from a rare spinal condition.
A calf is struggling with a suspected hernia; Matt investigates Maggie's condition; Julian removes one of the largest lumps his team has ever seen on a dog.

The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.
Gon and Killua fight Riehvelt and Gido; Hisoka praises Gon and offers to fight him.
Gon finally gets his fight with Hisoka.
Gon successfully lands a punch as the match with Hisoka reaches its conclusion.
Gon and Killua go to Whale Island, where Mito and her grandmother reveal Ging's past; Gon tries to open a box his father sent him.
Spurred on by Gon's father's message, Gon and Killua plan to go to Yorknew City.
Kurapika interviews for a bodyguard position that ties in with the Southern Piece Auction.
Kurapika and others battle to escape the mansion; Killua seeks information on Greed Island.
Gon and Killua gather info about Greed Island; the biggest auction in the world prepares to open.
Gon and friends try to raise money; the Phantom Troupe makes its move.
The Phantom Troupe attacks the underground auction, but their prize eludes them.
Uvogin slaughters the Mafia's pursuit, including their elite Shadow Beasts; Kurapika gets a chance to make his move against the Phantom Troupe.
Kurapika gets angry when Uvogin, his captive, makes demands; Hisoka contacts Kurapika to meet up.
Uvogin escapes and vows to get revenge on Kurapika; Kurapika must protect his employer from the Phantom Troupe after the gang discovers his location.
Kurapika and Uvogin come to blows as both combatants aim to settle a score.
Gon, Killua and Leorio, wanting to buy Greed Island, come up with a plan to make money by going to the auction market to bid low on surefire treasures; Leorio investigates the Phantom Troupe.
Gon and his friends hope to win the reward placed on the Phantom Troupe; Machi and Nobunaga search for the "chain user"; Gon and Killua receive a tip and begin shadowing the two Troupe members.
The Phantom Troupe captures Gon and Killua and interrogates them for information on the "chain user"; Killua begins to suspect the user's true identity.

The Mafia expects the Phantom Troupe to attack the rescheduled auction; the Ten Dons hire multiple assassins to deal with the Phantom Troupe; Light Nostrade sends Kurapika to join the assassins in dispatching the Troupe.
The Phantom Troupe attacks the auction; only Zeno and Silva can withstand the relentless assault.
The leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead, and Kurapika is shocked by the news; unconvinced, he tries to get a glimpse of the body; the dead bodies of the other Troupe members have been discovered.
Kurapika meets up with Gon and Killua; Kurapika reveals his Nen ability; Chrollo reads the future of Troupe members.
Chrollo uses his new ability to predict the future and predicts that Hisoka is a traitor; Kurapika and Gon plan to capture Pakunoda.

Chrollo uses the information he has on Neon to identify the location of the chain user, Kurapika; Killua is keeping an eye on the Phantom Troupe base when he is joined by Melody, who helps determine that the Troupe is headed towards Kurapika's hotel.

Gon and Killua are captives of the spiders; Kurapika, Melody, and Leorio hatch a plan to capture Chrollo and use him as leverage to force the remaining Phantom Troupe members to release Gon and Killua.
Kurapika has captured Chrollo; he offers to release Chrollo if Pakunoda brings Gon and Killua to him; however, Kurapika is unable to control his emotions in the presence of the Troupe leader.

The game Greed Island is finally on the auction block; Gon and Killua ask the purchaser to hire them as players, but they're told that their Nen is too weak; they begin to work on special abilities so they can be selected as players.
Gon and Killua want to be Greed Island players, but must demonstrate their Nen to a judge to land one of the 32 available spots.
Gon and Killua enter the world of Greed Island in hopes of finding Ging.
Gon and Killua encounter tough monsters as their quest for spell cards leads them toward Masadora; a mysterious girl named Biscuit observes the two as they fight.
When Biscuit defeats Binolt, Gon and Killua ask her to be their master.
Gon and Killua continue to improve their Nen and work together to gather more monster cards; Bisky advances them to the final stage of their training.
Gon develops a new technique based on rock-paper-scissors; Killua must leave Greed Island temporarily to take the Hunter Exam, leaving Gon and Bisky to deal with Genthru.
With Killua back, the three hunters resume collecting cards, but they still face adversaries who intend to beat them to the goal.
After deceiving Team Tsezguerra, Team Genthru has 96 restricted card slots; Gon and Killua try to stop Genthru from winning by monopolizing Path of Shore.
Gon and his friends make it to Soufrabi and challenge the pirate boss, Razor, to a team sports battle; the hunters head to Aiai, "The City of Love."
Gon, Hisoka and Goreinu challenge Razor; Razor challenges them to dodgeball.
Gon is sent to the outfield; he needs Killua's help to defeat Razor.
Gon, Killua and Hisoka must catch Razor's strongest throw in order to be crowned the dodgeball winner.
Hisoka seeks a Nen user with a unique power; Tsezguerra tries to beat Genthru to win the game; Gon keeps training as Killua gives his hands a rest.

After Team Tsezguerra leaves the game, Mr. Battera reveals the true purpose behind why he purchased so many Greed Island games; Genthru approaches Team Gon to propose a deal for the two remaining cards they require.
Gon faces Genthru alone and makes a last-minute change to his team's plan that risks utter defeat; another game must take place for the last #00 card.
Gon and his friends finally defeat Genthru and collect 99 trading cards.
Gon and Killua head out to meet someone who they hope is Ging; Gon arrives, the man starts yelling at them.
Gon and Killua decide to join Kite and his team in their research mission gathering information on the Chimera Ants.
Kite has narrowed down the location of the Chimera Ants.
Gon and his friends enter the NGL; the Chimera Ants start going through surprising changes.
The Chimera Ants have acquired weapons after attacking Gyro, the shadow leader of the NGL underground.
Gon and his friends come face-to-face with Chimera Ants for the first time.
The Chimera Ants become increasingly vicious after eating the members of the NGL underground.
The Hunter Association sets out to eliminate the Chimera Ants; Gon and his friends become the targets of a squad of Chimera Ants.
Hagya attacks Gon, Killua and Kite; the first of the Queen's Royal Guards is about to be born.
Kite, Gon and Killua continue using Nen to follow Hagya to the Chimera Ant's nest.
Gon and Killua vow to get stronger so they can return and rescue Kite.
Gon and Killua proceed with Biscuit's training.
A star opens an opportunity for Zeppeli and Jonathan; a prophecy from Zeppeli's past unfolds; a true hero triumphs.
Jonathan sets out to save Poco's sister with a team of Hamon masters; when a demon strikes, Jonathan steps in, igniting a war.
Jonathan marries Erina before traveling to America, but two stowaways change the course of history for all passengers.
Joseph arrives in New York and wastes no time brandishing his innate tendencies.
Bullets fly and Hamon reverberates as brassy Joseph battles the Hamon master-turned-vampire Straizo; an ominous revelation pulls Joseph to Mexico.
In search of the mysterious Pillar Man, Joseph arrives in Mexico to promising news and deadly resistance; the German army's thirst for power may have awakened an unstoppable power.

Trading blows with Santviento, Joseph employs his usual wit, but the jokes fall as flat as the Hamon; Stroheim surprises as he sheds light on the lethal Pillar Men, leaving Joseph hanging in more ways than one.
Joseph and Speedwagon travel to Rome to meet another Hamon wielder, Caesar Zeppeli, who takes them to the enigmatic Pillar Men; while Joseph and Caesar clash, they arrive to find a grim awakening.
Caesar confronts Wamuu and the other Pillar Men, but falters, clearing the way for Joseph; anxiety replaces audacity as Joseph's plan invites a presumable death sentence.
In mysterious Venice, Joseph and Caesar begin training under the equally enigmatic Lisa Lisa.
Under Lisa Lisa's tutelage, Joseph and Caesar must endure their final test; Caesar hones his skills; an ancient and unexpected foe stuns Joseph.
Joseph returns to Lisa Lisa, unaware of the bizarre stowaway he has delivered; a possessed confidant then attacks, ultimately sending the crew to Switzerland, where another revelation awaits.
Stroheim returns from the brink as a cyborg designed to secure the great Red Stone; Kars is not willing to concede and wages war, even as the stone hurtles toward an alpine cliff.
Lisa Lisa paints a picture of honor when she reveals Caesar's tragic past to Joseph; in the face of certain danger, Caesar enters into a solitary battle to avenge his father.
Inside a shadowy St. Moritz hotel, danger leaves Joseph and Lisa Lisa no time to mourn as they follow a bloody trail to Wamuu and Kars; Lisa Lisa manages to strike a deal -- with one condition.
Joseph and Wamuu finally face off in an equestrian one-on-one; Joseph's adroit attacks and weapon-grasping prowess may not be enough to keep Wamuu's millennia-old pride in check.
When the battle between Wamuu and Joseph comes to a head, the surprising confessions aren't far behind.

With Lisa Lisa's life on the line, Joseph must deceive the deceiver; joining Joseph, Stroheim and Speedwagon arrive at the battlefield, where a family tragedy threatens to doom the world to a hopeless future.
Having seized the Red Stone and the mask, Kars has become the Ultimate Being; now the seemingly invincible entity has his sights solely on Joseph who has one final trick up his sleeve.
Deep within a volcano's molten lava, Kars contemplates a comeback, but with the Red Stone's power unleashed, both warriors are launched into the stratosphere of the unknown.
A young man who is a descendant of the Joestar clan, Jotaro Kujo, refuses to leave a jail cell because he believes he is possessed by an evil spirit.
Jotaro finds out that the evil spirit he has is actually called a Stand, and tries to hide its existence as he tries to live a normal life.
With his evolved Stand powers, Jotaro defeats Kakyoin, an assassin sent by DIO.
Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think DIO is hiding, and run into another one of DIO's assassins on the plane.

Jotaro and his comrades are attacked by Polnareff, an assassin with a Stand called Silver Chariot that is capable of lightning-fast swordplay. It falls to Avdol to face down the threat using Magician's Red.
On a boat journey to Singapore, a stowaway is found and causes a commotion and then Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.
The group manages to escape the boat that was destroyed by the fake captain and drift on an emergency boat.
Jotaro and crew arrive in Singapore and once they get to their hotel, they separate; Polnareff finds Soul Sacrifice waiting for him in his room.
Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.
Jotaro and the others safely leave Singapore and enter India; Polnareff gets attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.
While trying to save Polnareff, Avdol gets struck down by the enemy's attack.
Jotaro and the others next head toward Varanasi; Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.
Polnareff drives a car on a very dangerous mountain road toward Pakistan, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.
Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan.

Polnareff finally realizes that Enyaba is another assassin from DIO and tries to warn the others, but Enyaba's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he gets pursued.
After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi, where they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel.
Dan of Steel's Stand, The Lovers, enters Joseph's brain; Dan tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey.
Jotaro and the others suspect someone is following them through the desert on their way to Cairo.
Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card.
Kakyoin tries to convince everyone that he's not crazy by showing them that his arm has "Baby Strand" carved into it.
Jotaro and the others visit an island on the Red Sea and meet Avdol's father.
Polnareff gets attacked by his sister after he revives her using one of the wishes he received.
Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine to travel through the Red Sea as they head toward Egypt where DIO awaits.
Jotaro and the others try to escape as the submarine begins sinking from an attack from the enemy Stand, High Priestess.
Jotaro and the others arrive in Egypt, and are joined by a Boston terrier named Iggy.
Avdol sets a trap for N'Doul, but it doesn't work.
Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt in the battle with N'doul, and are taken to a hospital in Aswan.
Jojo and the others look for a boat to take to Cairo where DIO awaits; Chaka walks along a nearby beach where he finds a sword that glows.
Polnareff defeats Chaka the Anubis Stand user, but the barber he visits suddenly starts talking about Anubis and attacks him.
Jotaro and the others arrive in Luxor; Joseph sees an electrical outlet in a rock and gets shocked when he investigates.
Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized.
Jotaro gets concerned that Joseph and Avdol haven't shown up yet, and goes to look for them.
Because of the power of Alessi's Stand, Set, Polnareff is turned back into a child.
After a long journey, Jotaro and the others finally reach Cairo and start looking for DIO's mansion.

The Try Guys get consultations from Dr. Diamond, a world-famous celebrity plastic surgeon, and are photoshopped with the most perfect version of their faces.

Keith and Zach try their hand at grooming adoptable puppies for the first time!
When Sun Mei and Red vanish, 10K and the group must decide whether to keep looking for them, or give up and press on to Newmerica.
Following Warren's dream, the team doesn't stop while crossing The Great Pile, a seemingly endless landscape of rubble and destruction.
The team is captured by an Unseen Force and enslaved in an elaborate underground facility, forced by their mysterious captors to perform a series of bizarre, dangerous tasks.
Lucy fights to save Murphy's life; Warren and the others battle a biologically modified Franken-Zombie guarding a clue to Warren's dream.
Shaken by the death of one of the team, something snaps in Murphy, and Warren is unable to stop him and the others from committing an atrocity as misplaced revenge.
Warren and the others encounter a mysterious stranger who they think is a grave robber, but they're something much more.
The group explores an abandoned TV news station and encounters news crew zombies triggering haunting flashbacks from day one.
Doc and the group are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working barber shop full of mysterious and murderous characters.
Warren's dream leads the group back to Mercy Labs where she must perform a dangerous task without knowing why.
Warren and the group must stop Zona from launching Operation Black Rainbow to cleanse the landscape of zombies and humans.
The secret of Warren's Black Rainbow dream is unlocked when they reach their final destination.
Warren recovers from the drone crash with handsome, mysterious Cooper; Doc and the others finally arrive in Newmerica, where they meet George, who is helping form the new country.
Warren must leave her new life behind and find her way to Newmerica, reuniting with Murphy and the other heroes, while discovering George is an old friend.
10K nearly loses everything as Panic and anti-Talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote.
Warren and George search for Lt. Dante, who may be part of an underground network helping Talkers flee human vigilantes.
Pacifica is bombed, and the heroes decide to follow the Talker Underground to stop whoever is behind the attacks.
Warren and the others are reunited with Addy in Limbo, an underground casino run by Murphy and his Blends that shelters Talkers on the run from Altura Militia.

As Doc explains his version of American history to George, Sketchy and Skeezy re-enact Doc's stories about the Founding Fathers; Warren and the others go to the bakery that invented bizkits in search of the secret ingredient.
The heroes arrive in the farming outpost that produces flour for biscuits and find it overrun by zombies.
Doc must spirit walk again to help save the Chief of the Water Keepers and get the water flowing to Newmerica.
Altura militiamen force Talkers to mine a hazardous waste landfill for the secret ingredient to biscuits.
With some help from an outpost of renegade hackers, Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.
Warren and the others must free the Talkers being held in Quarantine and prepare to attack Altura.
The heroes break into Altura in an attempt to bring Pandora and Estes to justice; Cooper reappears, shocking Warren; there's something he has to tell her.
In Upstate New York, a zombie baby proves to be an obstacle for a diverse group of survivors, as they head cross-country in hope of creating a cure for the living-dead condition.
When the survivors run out of fuel, they embark on a dangerous mission to replenish their source; in New Jersey, Cassandra's past comes back to haunt her.
In Philadelphia, a group of psychotic outlaws confronts the survivors and a connection exists between the two parties.
Soldier zombies in Washington, D.C.; Ten Thousand's mysterious past is revealed.
The survivors search for Warren's missing husband in Central Illinois; a zombie tornado threatens the group.
A utopian enclave may not be all it seems near Branson, Mo.; the group's encounter with a religious cult may cause drastic changes.
Featuring easy makeup and fashion hacks, lighthearted pranks and funny observations; entertaining and positive shows about everything trending right now.
Featuring easy makeup and fashion hacks, lighthearted pranks, and funny observations. 123 GO! Delivers entertaining and positive shows about everything trending right now.

Eric Sloane (Dennis Alexio) is an American kickboxing pro, helped by his brother, Kurt (Jean-Claude Van Damme), in his quest for glory. But when the two go to Thailand to take on legendary Tong Po (Michel Qissi), the opponent viciously beats Eric and leaves him paralyzed. Swearing vengeance, Kurt tracks down master Xian Chow (Dennis Chan) and begins learning the sport himself while also getting caught up in criminal intrigue involving thuggish crime boss Freddy Li (Ka Ting Lee).
An American kickboxer heads to South Africa to find the promoter responsible for the deaths of two friends.

Once a first-rate Secret Service agent, Joe Hallenbeck (Bruce Willis) is now a gruff private investigator whose latest gig is protecting a pole dancer (Halle Berry). When she's murdered, he grudgingly teams up with her boyfriend, Jimmy Dix (Damon Wayans), an ex-quarterback with a gambling problem, and the two go after her killers. Before long, they stumble onto a plot by a well-known football magnate (Noble Willingham) to bribe federal legislators into legalizing sports gambling.

Winslow Lowry (Anthony Geary) is a greedy man determined to get his hands on the fortune of his ailing and very wealthy uncle, Albert Dennison (Ralph Bellamy). As a way to hasten Uncle Albert's death, Winslow puts him in the care of three hapless orderlies -- Buffy, Markie and Kool, also known as the Fat Boys (The Fat Boys) -- but their jolly dispositions actually make the elderly man feel better. When Winslow steps up his devious efforts, can the trio stop him?

Foxx portrays Michael Dawson, a successful Chicago businessman whose life falls apart while he's driving to the Grand Canyon with his gorgeous fiancé, Rae. When Rae discovers that he has used their savings to buy the car, she cuts off the engagement and leaves him behind. Intent on driving back to Chicago to win Rae back, Michael instead finds himself stuck in a hillbilly town.
An experienced assassin works for both sides of a Russian gang war and becomes the target of a hidden enemy.

Once a narcotics officer in the LAPD, Ray Owens settles into a peaceful life as sheriff of Sommerton Junction, a quiet border town. That peace is shattered when Gabriel Cortez, a vicious crime lord, escapes from FBI custody and speeds toward Ray's town with a band of mercenaries. Federal agents prepare to capture Cortez. Ray is at first reluctant to get involved, but he soon finds he must rally his team and take matters into his own hands.
Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

John Cutter (Wesley Snipes) is a former policeman flying to Los Angeles to start his new job working for the anti-terrorism unit of a major airline. However, apprehended terrorist Charles Rane (Bruce Payne) is on the flight, too, being transported by the FBI. After Rane's accomplices kill the FBI agents and free him, Cutter realizes the entire flight is in danger. With the help of flight attendant Marti Slayton (Alex Datcher), Cutter tries to capture Rane and free the passengers.

After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge.

Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

For many years, Nathan Harper (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that life with his family isn't quite what it seems. His fears come true when he finds a picture of himself as a youngster on a missing-persons website, proof that the people he's called mom and dad his whole life are not his real parents. As he draws close to uncovering his true identity, Nathan becomes the target of assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen (Lily Collins), the only person he can now trust.

Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

Tragedy strikes on April 15, 2013, when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon. In the aftermath of the attack, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders (Mark Wahlberg), FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers (Kevin Bacon) and Commissioner Ed Davis (John Goodman) join courageous survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the suspects and bring them to justice.

After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.
Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.
An Elvis impersonator, meth-addicted white supremacists, and a man searching for his wife hunt for a missing wedding ring.

Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.
Movie, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Action

A group of old college friends reunite for a Juneteenth weekend getaway, only to find themselves trapped in a remote cabin with a twisted killer. Forced to play by his rules, they soon realize this isn't a game.

In New York City in 1987, a handsome, young urban professional, Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale), lives a second life as a gruesome serial killer by night. The cast is filled by the detective (Willem Dafoe), the fiancé (Reese Witherspoon), the mistress (Samantha Mathis), the coworker (Jared Leto), and the secretary (Chloë Sevigny). This is a biting, wry comedy examining the elements that make a man a monster.
A man's body is found in Denton canal, and Frost unravels a series of crimes involving blackmail.
Frost joins a gym; a body is found at a recycling plant; businessman is caught in an embarrassing situation.
Frost joins forces with Christine Moorhead during a raid on a dogfight in which a boy is killed.
A woman's body is found on a train at the same time a female surgeon is reported missing; someone makes indecent assaults while impersonating Frost.
Reid learns the identity of the assailant impersonating Frost, and the knowledge may cost both their lives.
Frost has issues with his new partner.
Frost connects two previous deaths to his current case.
A witness to an underworld slaying disappears before she can testify, and Frost tries to find her before a hit man kills her.
Frost begins a manhunt for a serial killer when he uncovers a web of lies surrounding the investigation into the murder of a widow.

Frost is called to investigate when a couple returns from holiday to find the body of a complete stranger in their bed. He also uncovers a crime ring involved in the importation of endangered species.
Family, Crime drama, Mystery, Drama, Historical drama
An unsolved case is reopened when remains are found; a suspected killer is released from prison.
Frost is called when a Denton bus driver and conductor are kidnapped; series of credit card thefts.
Jack Frost investigates three naked male bodies forming a triangle; a businessman smears the owner of a youth club in order to get the property.
Gwinnett County detectives chase down a bullet-ridden Toyota Camry to find who may have killed a beloved young man.
In Tulsa, three people are executed in their ransacked home, and the woman who found them may hold the key to finding the killer.
In Mobile, Ala., when two beloved men from the Mobile Terrace neighborhood are gunned down, detectives need the community's help to get justice for their families.
When a hardworking construction worker is brutally murdered on payday, Tulsa detectives discover he's fallen prey to a seemingly unlikely attacker.
Born and raised in Mobile, Ala., Cpl. Jermaine Rogers has deep roots in his city, covering three cases in which Rogers has a personal connection to the people involved in his investigations.

ALF and his friends portray an amusing fight against injustice in a jazzed-up version of the classic tale, "Robin Hood", which is considered one of the best in English folklore.

Staggering under failures, the Aladdin brothers wind up in a desert amid a tour and stumble upon a magic lamp that houses a genie in a modern retelling of a popular middle-eastern folk tale.

ALF and his friends add their own twist to "Peter Pan", the story of a boy who lives in a magical land, never grows up, and befriends three children of a family in the real world.
ALF and his friends present their revamped version of the German classic, "Hansel and Gretel", wherein a brother-sister duo must save themselves from a dreadful witch.

Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.

Survivors band together after an explosion at a military bioweapons plant turns most of their neighbors into flesh-eating zombies.
A pregnant police officer and a blind man fight for their lives against swarms of the living dead.

The creature that emerges soon becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare, plunging Tinja into a twisted reality that her mom refuses to see.

After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.
Investigadores exploran eventos extraños en un barrio de Buenos Aires.

Alma y sus hijos son asesinados en el conflicto armado de Guatemala. Treinta años después, se entabla una demanda penal contra Enrique, un general retirado que supervisó el genocidio, pero al ser absuelto viene a por él un espíritu vengativo.

Manolo y Candela se instalan en el madrileño barrio de Malasaña, junto a sus tres hijos y el abuelo Fermín, provenientes de un pueblo. La familia llega a la capital en busca de prosperidad, pero no sospechan que en la casa que han comprado no están solos.

La salud de los enfermos empeora drásticamente aunque Hershel trate de salvar sus vidas como pueda. Rick revela a Maggie qué ha pasado con Carol, mientras que en las murallas de la prisión una muchedumbre de zombis amenaza con destruir la valla.

Tras la caída de Woodbury, el Gobernador vaga sin rumbo hasta que encuentra a una familia cuyo patriarca está moribundo. El Gobernador se encariña especialmente con Lilly, una niña autista a la que promete proteger siempre.
El Gobernador se da cuenta de que el grupo de Martínez es débil, a pesar de que tienen un gran arsenal. Además, localiza a quienes le arrebataron todo lo que tenía.
El Gobernador captura a Hershel y Michonne y exige al grupo salir de la prisión. Sin embargo, Rick y su gente no van a dejarse vencer sin presentar batalla.

Después de la batalla contra el Gobernador, Rick y Carl encuentran una casa en la que Rick intenta reponerse de sus graves heridas y Carl sale en busca de alimentos. Mientras, Michonne trata de encontrarlos.

Los sobrevivientes del ataque vagan por el bosque, diseminados en grupos pequeños, en busca de cobijo. Tyreese, Lizzie y Mika se topan con una antigua conocida. Mientras, Daryl y Beth buscan a los demás y Glenn despierta en la prisión solo.
Rick, Carl y Michonne se encuentran con un grupo de hombres extremadamente peligrosos en una casa aparentemente vacía. Mientras, Glenn y Tara conocen a unas personas que viajan hacia Washington D. C.

Daryl y Beth siguen viajando juntos y Beth le revela que no quiere morir sin haber probado nunca el alcohol. A pesar de que Daryl se muestra contrario a sus intenciones, Beth se emborracha y, de esta forma, ambos se conocen mejor.

Mientras buscan Terminus, Maggie, Sasha y Bob discuten fuertemente y terminan separándose, sin percatarse de que son más vulnerables estando solos. Mientras, Daryl y Beth han encontrado cobijo en una funeraria, pero una horda de zombis los ataca.
Tyreese, Carol, Lizzie, Mika y Judith llegan a una cabaña mientras buscan Terminus. Allí, Lizzie enloquece y muestra una fascinación por la muerte que hiela la sangre de Carol y Tyreese.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
Goes beyond the forecast to give you the how and why about stuff you wanted to ask about weather, space and science.

After his ship sinks, Andrew Braddock (Michael York) washes ashore on a tropical island owned by Dr. Moreau (Burt Lancaster). While waiting for a ship to return him to civilization, Braddock becomes disturbed by the strange creatures roaming the island, and at the same time falls for the lovely Maria (Barbara Carrera), who lives with Moreau. Soon Braddock discovers that the creatures are the results of Moreau's sinister experiments, and plots to escape before he himself becomes a victim.

A poor street cleaner is relentlessly bullied by the people of a small western township, but things change when a ruthless gunfighter rides into the town.
A bounty hunter (John Saxon) tracks a large ex-convict (Rosey Grier) who attacks prison guards with a steel riot glove.

When a bank heist goes wrong, outlaw Yellowleg (Brian Keith) inadvertently kills a 9-year-old boy -- the son of saloon girl Kit Tildon (Maureen O'Hara). Plagued by guilt over the shooting, Yellowleg vows to help her bury the boy beside his father in the now-derelict town of Siringo, Ariz. With criminal cohorts Billy (Steve Cochran) and Turk (Chill Wills), Yellowleg embarks on a dangerous journey into Apache territory to lay the boy in his final resting place.

He and Jun agree to a partnership, but, when Wilson's cover is blown, Jun is forced to confront the gang the only way he knows how: with his fists.

Kevin's new career as a child actor quickly hits the skids when his big break causes him to get an even bigger head.
While speaking before Kevin's class for Career Day, Nick confuses the students by implying that building connections is more important than studying hard and getting good grades.
When the entire Kingston-Persons's clan plus guests end up at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, Suzanne has to scramble to find the one item she was in charge of - the turkey.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop and Nick being the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.

Suzanne meets a relationship expert and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.
Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.
When Nick gets a doctors report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.
After balking at the high price of a purse Suzanne loves, Nick thinks again and tries to buy it as a gift - but Suzanne has already secretly bought the last purse for herself.
Nick discovers Suzanne's wedding ring is not actually real and sets out to have a real ring made before she learns the truth, while Suzanne thinks she has lost her wedding ring forever.

Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.
Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.
While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses. The kids want a larger allowance, but they are not willing to do more chores in return for a higher payout.
When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.
When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way, forcing KAWT employees to undergo sensitivity training.
When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.
The entire family plays pranks on one another. However, when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it is another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.
When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go. The family realises they need Suzanne's ways to run a successful household.
Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama jumper online. Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.
Nick helps out Willie Mays, a homeless man with a beautiful voice, by getting him a job at KAWT, but Willie takes advantage of his new job.
Lindsey gets high when her friend gives her a drug and learns a hard lesson.
Nick says he is too tired for marital relations one night, leading Suzanne to speculate and have major concerns that something is not right in their relationship.

When Suzanne wants a real honeymoon, Nick tries to plan an extravagant surprise, but despite his best efforts to create something romantic, instead misleads Suzanne into thinking he is cheating on her.
Suzanne and Nick go on a People's Court-type TV show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve. However, the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.
Kevin helps Frankie study for a test, but Frankie bribes him to take the test for him.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his proposal-versary with Suzanne, who is none too pleased. The children star in internet videos wearing superhero costumes.
When Suzanne is overly protective teaching Lindsey how to drive, Nick takes over and makes Lindsey feel confident, until she scratches Suzanne's car and chooses to lie about the incident.
When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.
Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online. But when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.
When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.
Nick is forced to get an assistant, who is a must-hire from his boss. But when the assistant gets too close to his family and friends, Nick is forced to take action.

Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk at The Big Box Club discount super store that the family does not need. Meanwhile, Lindsey enters a speed-texting contest.
Nick is disappointed when Frank crashes his Father's Day trip. However, when a lift stops, the men are forced to have a meaningful heart-to-heart.

Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.
Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains. Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.

Prosecuting attorney Raymond Horgan (Brian Dennehy) assigns his chief deputy, the taciturn Rusty Sabitch (Harrison Ford), to investigate the rape and murder of colleague Carolyn Polhemus (Greta Scacchi), unaware of their torrid affair. Willy Beachum (Ryan Gosling), a hotshot prosecutor, is about to leave his post for a lucrative job at a private law firm when his boss (David Strathairn) hands him a seemingly open-and-shut case. Ted Crawford (Anthony Hopkins) tried to kill his wife with a shot to the head and is defending himself in court. All hope for a quick and easy trial flies out the door when Ted proves to be a more cunning and devious adversary than Willy anticipates.

A Hong Kong police detective, Chan Ka Kui (Jackie Chan), works with the CIA to track a mysterious woman named Natasha (Grishajeva Nonna). Traveling from Hong Kong to Ukraine to Australia, Chan aims to bust up the terrorist plot using his fists as much as his brains, doing battle underwater, on stilts and across mountain tops.

After her husband's death, Beth Macauley moves into an inexpensive Baltimore apartment with her two sons, Chris and Matt. When Beth accepts a job at a local grocery store, Chris grows bitter and falls for an older woman, while 9-year-old Matt hides his grief behind a new interest in burglary. As the Macauleys adjust to their new life, they learn that sticking together is the only way to overcome their loss.

Upon breaking out of a dungeon, youthful thief Phillipe Gaston (Matthew Broderick) befriends Capt. Navarre (Rutger Hauer), a man with a strange secret. His dark magic prevents the pair from ever being in each other's presence except at twilight, so they enlist Gaston in a dangerous plot to overthrow the Bishop and break his evil enchantment.

El novio de Jess actúa de forma cómica en su relación; el novio de Jessica, un árbitro de profesión, toma malas decisiones.
Kitty Ramsey atrapa a su novia música tocándole las teclas a otra. Harmoniee Vance se entera de que su novio acaba de tener un bebé con otra.
El novio de Eryn cultiva el infierno en su rancho; el novio de Mimi divide su amor con otra mujer.
El esposo de Nicole entretiene a otra mujer en su segundo hogar; el hombre de la motocicleta de Stephanie monta sucio con otra mujer.
Las actividades extracurriculares de la novia de Ian; la novia de Richard recibe besos de otro hombre.
Larry encuentra a su novia desempleada pidiendo besos a otro hombre; Kristina descubre que su novio pasa el tiempo con otra mujer.
Tobyn Burke pilla a su novia vendedora ofreciéndole su amor a otro. Más adelante, Byron Halpern descubre que a su novia le gusta fumar y sobar a otros.

El novio de Jennifer coquetea con varias mujeres; el prometido de Kay, dueño de un restaurante tiene una acompañante deliciosa.

Brandi Landry pilla a su novio sudando la gota gorda con otra. Brice Paul descubre que a su novia le gusta fumar y sudar con otro.
