Tony se entera de que su esposa ha vuelto a sus andanzas. Tatum encuentra a su novio conociendo a otras chicas en una app.
Rayne Brown está preocupada porque su novio cada día trabaja más. Amy Stajan siente que solo le interesa a su novio cuando él necesita dinero.
Lexi McLeod trabaja de día y su novio de noche, lo cual nunca había sido un problema hasta ahora. Pierre Terry no entiende por qué su novia está distante.
Nate cree que su novia puede estar usándolo por su dinero. Christian quiere controlar a Tata.

La esposa de Larry Grant no siempre le contesta el teléfono y solamente se va a dormir temprano cuando él está de viaje. Bridget Braun siente que es momento de dar el siguiente paso, pero su novio está más distante que nunca.
Christian quiere saber por qué Celeste es tan reservada con su vida personal. Por su parte, Amber quiere saber el motivo tras las frecuentes duchas y cortes de pelo de Robert.
Shalyce intenta averiguar por qué Rod parece estar evitándola. Hailey quiere saber por qué Mike no contesta el teléfono cuando lo llama.

La seductora agente secreto Helena regresa para cumplir una nueva misión: debe infiltrarse en el círculo privado de un científico genial, de quien sospechan que ha desarrollado un virus altamente mortal y contagioso.
Una manera más relajada de comenzar el día.

Ricardo Soto está casado con Miranda Robles, una mujer guapa con una afortunada posición social. Su esposo aprovechará esta situación para ponerle el cuerno con una jovencita mucho menor que él, sin recordar que el que ríe al último, ríe mejor.
Cata termina con su novio y supone que volverá de rodillas, rogando casarse con ella. Pero tiempo después lo encuentra siendo el hombre perfecto y a punto de casarse con otra.
Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.
Elena es una escurridiza ladrona y artista del disfraz. Al verse perseguida por la policía, se disfraza de monja y se refugia en un convento, donde seguirá cometiendo imprudencias.

Jackie es una joven que disfruta de ayudar a los más necesitados, pero su esposo Samuel no comparte este sentimiento. Un trágico accidente lo deja en coma y entonces ella decide seguir su vida y volverse a enamorar.

Dos jóvenes se reencuentran en otra vida. Alejandro reconoce a Yolanda, quien pertenece a una extraña familia y a la que él culpa de la muerte de su padre. Alejandro busca el secreto detrás de la muerte de su padre.
Ellie y Martín son dos recién casados que han perdido sus respectivos trabajos y tienen que irse a vivir a casa de los padres de ella.
Una mujer (Jennifer Esposito) enumera las cualidades de su hombre perfecto, luego se enamora de un chico (David Sutcliffe) que no cumple ninguno de sus criterios.

Tori es una deportista que le da poca importancia a la moda, el maquillaje y las apariencias. Sin embargo, cuando se enamora de un colega, decide transformarse y volverse más femenina para conquistarlo.
Años después de sufrir un trágico accidente, una atleta de patinaje artístico acepta entrenar a una joven estudiante.
Un niño blanco (Zak Ludwig) y un compañero moreno (Jaishon Fisher) se hacen amigos cuando su padre (Billy Ray Cyrus) y la abuela (Candus Churchill) los obligan a pasar un tiempo juntos.
Una mujer (Lesley Ann Warren) enferma terminal quiere revelar un secreto de toda la vida acerca de su mejor amiga (Meredith Baxter) y su hija (Bridget Ann White).
Un hombre (Jack Coleman) se reúne con su banda de la preparatoria para presentarse en el baile de gala de su hija (Cassi Thomson).
Una guardaespaldas tiene una misión encubierta como dama de honor en la boda de la hija de un magnate, después de recibir una serie de amenazas de muerte.
Una pareja (Jonathan Silverman, DeDee Pfeiffer) y sus hijos adolescentes se reencuentran mientras están en un rancho en las montañas.
Un hombre cuyo aspecto le es familiar puede ser la respuesta a un antiguo deseo navideño de una mujer de 33 años.
El amor lo conquista todo cuando la hija de un ranchero lleva a su novio a casa para la Navidad.

Abby es una organizadora de bodas especializada en arreglar bodas que salieron mal. Obligada a trabajar con su exprometido, pronto empieza a cuestionarse si su relación fue el desastre que ella recuerda.
Después de heredar la mitad del viñedo de su tío, una mujer debe trabajar con el copropietario durante tres semanas o arriesgarse a perder la tierra.
Una mujer viaja a un castillo irlandés después de que su compromiso termina una semana antes de su boda.

Christine, un duende de Santa, se pregunta si podría haber más en la vida que la fabricación de juguetes en el Polo Norte y consigue un trabajo durante las vacaciones, ayudando a una familia en la planificación de un evento de caridad.

Luego de aceptar un trabajo temporal en un laboratorio, César comienza a notar extraños sucesos relacionados con el tratamiento de un paciente con el número 27, esto le perturba al punto de causarle insomnio y alucinaciones.
Mercedes está obsesionada con subir al altillo de su casa. Ese lugar esconde un misterio. En otro lugar cuatro amigos reciben un llamado de Adrián, un amigo que no ven hace tiempo.
Gamal está enamorado de su nueva colega, Sara. Llega un invitado agresivo, y Gamal debe encontrar una manera de proteger a Sara de este y de la habitación.
El jefe de Gamal le encarga renovar la habitación. Los trabajadores se quedan sin palabras al encontrar huesos humanos en las paredes.

Después de una larga búsqueda, las autoridades atrapan al supuesto "asesino de Malagua", un individuo al cual se le acusa de asesinar cruelmente a más de veinte víctimas. Tras las rejas, es visitado por un reportero debido a los fuertes rumores de que él es la persona equivocada, por lo que cuenta la verdad de lo que realmente pasó.

Josué vive en una casa aislada. Su vida gira alrededor de los cuidados de un hermano demente al que debe mantener encerrado. Pero las rutinas y la vida de Josué se ven violentamente alteradas la noche que el hermano consigue escaparse.

Carla viaja a la misteriosa ciudad de Pyramiden, la ciudad más al norte del mundo, para crear una empresa de turismo extremo. Sergei, un guardia local, intentará por todos los medios impedir que lo consiga.

Lorenza se enamora del Diablo y tiene una hija llamada Rocío. Para proteger a Rocío, Lorenza guarda un secreto. Solo Marcela, una psicóloga, conoce la verdad: el Diablo necesita atraer a un asesino con sangre maldita para embarazar a Rocío y manifestarse en la Tierra.

Después de la desaparición de su esposa e hija, Tomás García, un investigador policial escéptico, entra en un estado de depresión en el que comienza a tener visiones de su esposa desaparecida, pero que le podrían dar respuesta a la desaparición.
Una fuerza sobrenatural ataca a un equipo de periodistas.

Rocío, una joven madre soltera con un hijo de ocho años, trata de ganarse la vida mediante trabajos ocasionales. Sin embargo, el mundo de ambos empieza a tambalear cuando una orden de desalojo amenaza con echarlos a la calle.
El abandono los une y el amor los enfrenta. El odio y la venganza se interponen en las vidas de dos hermanos.
Un joven que vive en una pequeña comunidad de pescadores de Costa Rica intenta ayudar a su hermano mayor, quien se ha entrometido en el camino de un peligroso narcotraficante.
En los 70, un agente encubierto (Eduardo Noriega) intenta infiltrarse al grupo terrorista vasco ETA.
La muerte de Fermín pone en la mira a su familia, su esposa y tres hijos, quienes tienen un futuro prometedor. Un suboficial y una agente investigarán que sucedió.
Jerónimo renta cuartos y revisa las pertenencias de las personas cuando ellas no están presentes. Sanna, una atractiva actriz noruega, entra a su vida y despierta algo nuevo en Jerónimo.
Un presentador de televisión se entera de que su familia está siendo secuestrada, y tiene que lidiar con el juego enfermizo del secuestrador mientras que anima en la televisión en vivo.
Chano, quien ha vivido siempre rodeado de delincuencia y corrupción, regresa al mundo del crimen con el fin de sacar a su sobrino de la cárcel.

Dani pasa las vacaciones con su amigo Nico y, juntos, aprovechan la situación para meterse de lleno en la vida del pueblo. Así conocen a dos chicas con las que dan los primeros pasos hacia la vida adulta.
Una batalla por el poder surge entre gánsteres americanos, mexicanos y coreanos.
A honeymooning couple has to survive in the Grand Canyon after getting lost.

The reappearance of his ex-girlfriend Jean (Katy Davis) threatens to put a damper on Tommy's (Andrew Scott) happy bachelorhood -- but he gets far more than he bargained for when he returns to his apartment to find her dead body. Fearful of becoming a murder suspect, Tommy hatches a plan with pal Noel (Darren Healy) to dispose of the body. But his perfect plan unravels when police dogs track down two corpses in the same place: Jean's, and that of a prominent politician's wife.

After a spree of horrific murders in the New Mexico desert, two FBI agents arrive at a small Santa Fe police station to interview the key witnesses. Using elaborate surveillance equipment to view the interrogations simultaneously, Sam Hallaway watches as his partner cross-examines the three survivors. As several inconsistencies emerge, it becomes clear that somebody in the room knows the truth behind the slayings.
Two sisters staying in a tourist trap battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes to save the ones they love.
Found footage reveals the events surrounding an investigative team's visit to a remote commune, led by a dangerous fanatic who maintains an iron grip on his followers.
During their annual vacation to the beach, Ben and Vee encounter a mysterious hiker who draws them into a twisted web of lies, deceit, revenge and ultimately, murder.
Hired to debunk a supposed haunting, paranormal investigators come face-to-face with an angry spirit more terrifying than they have ever imagined.
A cold-blooded killer hunts a widow in the wilderness after she escapes from his remote cabin in the Pacific Northwest.
Lilith, a succubus, emerges in the present day to seek revenge against mankind for her expulsion from the Garden of Eden.
A police detective, prosecutor and beat cop must stop a serial killer before they strike again.
A concert pianist who has stage fright finds a threatening note written on his sheet music just moments before a performance.

Heir to a real-estate dynasty, David Marks (Ryan Gosling) lives in the shadow of his father, Sanford (Frank Langella). He takes a chance at true love when he meets Katie (Kirsten Dunst), a woman of modest origins who sees David's real worth as a person, not just his family's wealth. David and Katie marry and plan to build a life together, but their once-loving relationship deteriorates after David gives in to his father's demand that he work in the family business.
When a beautiful bride-to-be is bitten by the legendary creature Bigfoot, she becomes a brutal force of nature, hellbent on breaking her engagement... and her fiancé.

During the time of the bubonic plague in 14th-century England, young monk Osmund is recruited by the knight Ulric to lead a group of soldiers through the marshes into a mysterious village, where rumors are spreading that a necromancer is raising plague victims from the dead. Osmund agrees, but he has an ulterior motive—to find Averill, a young woman who has gone missing. Along the way, the group encounters unimagined darkness.
Gangsters and vampires collide in a gory battle.

Espacio de conversaciones para las grandes figuras del mundo deportivo. Más allá de los triunfos, se indaga sobre sus motivaciones, aprendizajes, desafíos, y todo sobre el lado humano detrás de cada victoria.

A lo largo de su carrera, la periodista Carolina Rocha ha recolectado las historias que encuentra en cada rincón de México. Con micrófono en mano, se ha encargado de relatar sobre gastronomía, folklore e historias de vida.
El "Messi de la Lucha Libre" habla de sus logros en IWRG y sobre sus próximos compromisos internacionales.

It is the penultimate night of the week from in and around reading, and the turn of telecoms manager Susan to host; with her intriguing Chicken Mole, she hopes to tickle everyone's taste buds and impress with her menu.
The last night of competition arrives for John, who serves a menu inspired by his love of all things Spanish, and works hard to keep his guests happy.
Featuring a Caribbean feast, a vegetable banquet and a dark horse.
In Nottingham, Derby and Leicester, Dylan offers a home from home experience, Sam treats her guests to fine dining, crystal healer Angela goes booze-free and Mod Aaron ends with a bang.
Features Sheffield's dining competitors Helen, Claire, Ben, Greg and Rosie.
Five strangers from Belfast, namely Steve, Julie, Justin, Cushla and Marty, compete to throw the best dinner party.

A young bachelor takes on four women in this culinary contest from Glasgow; all five are cooking their idea of the perfect dinner party, but this is hosting with a twist, as the guests mark one another's efforts.
Four contestants in Brighton compete to host the best dinner party.
Will it be a fairy tale ending for Diane, or will Kay show them how it's done?

When a British TV show becomes popular, an American network often makes its own version of the show. In this case, Lifetime is importing this series that pits four amateur cooks against one another as they compete for a cash prize. Each contestant prepares a meal for a dinner party -- with a unique theme, location and menu -- for the other competitors, who critique and score the cook. The contestant who earns the most points for his or her party wins the title of the host with the most and, more importantly, the money. Radio personality Todd Pettengill narrates the series.
Dave, Caroline and Tom try to serve up their best British meals; Andrea goes with a more oriental-inspired approach.
Battling it out in Marbella on the Costa del Sol are expats 50-year-old club comic John, outspoken businesswoman Lisa, front of house manager Michelle and 44-year-old estate agent and socialite Ross.
Office manager Julie serves her guests some hearty comfort food to win them over; however, not all the dishes impress.
Gail sets out to impress with some gourmet dining; to her, the color-matched cutlery and placemats are just as important as the meal -- however, her guests don't feel the same.
Surfer Ben welcomes guests to his beachside apartment for a relaxed dining atmosphere with the theme of Australiana.
Jennifer hosts a Mexicana-themed dinner party as a tribute to her birth land; she makes a very hot salsa that leaves her guests in tears.
Former pop-star Richard cooks up a hearty English meal; however, his dinner party may not impress enough to win the prize.

Los oficiales atienden un robo de auto en un supermercado. El sospechoso es sorprendido dentro de una camioneta y al resistirse es lastimado. La policía lo arresta por transgresión después de un aviso, por entrar a un auto y alterar el orden público.

La policía busca un auto reportado como robado, pero el sospechoso tiene un accidente al intentar escapar y es arrestado por ambos delitos. Un exmilitar es detenido por una infracción vehicular, pero el oficial encuentra una bolsa grande de marihuana.

Un hombre es perseguido por traer drogas, la policía logra atraparlo y descubre que tiene un arma cargada y que tal vez tragó metanfetamina. Es un traficante conocido, tiene un largo historial y recibe nuevos cargos.
Un operativo de narcóticos se lleva a cabo con el apoyo de un nuevo sistema de seguridad de alta tecnología, el cual busca atrapar a dos traficantes.

La policía detiene a un joven en bicicleta por circular en la banqueta y, al revisarlo, descubren que está armado, así que es arrestado y llevado a la Corte. Se reporta un intento de robo con una navaja: el sujeto es sorprendido dentro de una camioneta.

Los oficiales patrullan una zona suburbana cuando un conductor ignora las señales de alto y provoca una persecución a gran velocidad. Tras detenerlo, descubren drogas y un arma en el vehículo mientras vecinos observan la intensa operación policial.

Un oficial enfrenta a un grupo de motociclistas que van conduciendo sin luces y de forma imprudente, y con el apoyo de un helicóptero policial logran ubicar y arrestar a uno de ellos. La policía recibe un reporte sobre una mujer por abuso sexual.

La policía está buscando una camioneta Jeep robada y, al enfrentar al conductor, se inicia una persecución a toda velocidad, provocando un accidente. El delincuente es detenido por ignorar a la autoridad y conducir un auto robado.

Un oficial atiende el reporte sobre un hombre que agredió a varias personas en un edificio. El sujeto se esconde en un departamento con menores de edad, es acusado de robo, agresión y actos dolosos. Otra persona es golpeada en la cabeza.

Varias patrullas participan en una intensa persecución para atrapar a un auto sospechoso. Los pasajeros son detenidos y enfrentan cargos por posesión de armas y evidencia de actos ilícitos. Un hombre es arrestado por poner resistencia ante la policía.

Se realiza un operativo para recuperar un auto robado que se encuentra en una casa. El delincuente intenta escapar y evadir a los oficiales. La policía interviene en una pelea entre dos individuos en una tienda.

Se lleva a cabo la persecución de un auto en la carretera, la conductora se resiste a detenerse, por lo que se utiliza una cadena de púas. La mujer es llevada a la cárcel por tener órdenes de arresto y tratar de huir de la policía.

Oficiales responden a una llamada por disturbios domésticos donde una discusión escala rápidamente. Más tarde, los oficiales detienen a un conductor que podría estar intoxicado y también con la búsqueda de un hombre que huye tras una disputa.

Una patrulla detiene a un hombre que coincide con la descripción de un sospechoso de robo. Más tarde responden a una pelea en vía pública que requiere intervención inmediata. El turno cierra con una parada de tráfico que revela órdenes pendientes.

Durante las celebraciones de Spring Break, agentes rescatan a un grupo de mujeres cuya despedida de soltera termina en problemas. En la playa, oficiales obligan a turistas a tirar alcohol ilegal y mientras un hombre vende cerveza de forma clandestina.

Oficiales patrullan la playa cuando una mujer detenida por beber en público intenta mentir sobre su edad. Más tarde, un grupo de jóvenes debe reparar un enorme hoyo que cavaron en la arena mientras otro visitante llama la atención de los agentes.

Mientras miles de turistas disfrutan del Spring Break, autoridades realizan pruebas para detectar sustancias ilegales y un equipo K-9 entrena en la arena para detectar explosivos. Un joven sorprende a los agentes al pedir una foto tras recibir una multa.

Un vendedor clandestino intenta aprovechar el ambiente festivo vendiendo bebidas alcohólicas mezcladas sin permiso. Además, una joven detenida nuevamente por beber siendo menor de edad intenta explicar por qué sigue usando el mismo vaso.

La fiesta se sale de control después de que un nadador necesita un rescate durante las vacaciones de primavera. En Cayo Hueso, los agentes desalojan a unos huéspedes problemáticos de una renta vacacional y lidian con vendedores y artistas callejeros.

Una patrulla detiene a un conductor sospechoso y la situación revela posibles violaciones relacionadas con el alcohol. En otro incidente, oficiales intervienen en altercados provocados por fiestas que se prolongan más allá de lo permitido.

Un sospechoso intenta huir de los agentes, pero pronto se queda sin opciones. Mientras tanto, oficiales responden a un incidente que involucra a conductores imprudentes y comportamientos peligrosos en la vía pública.

Una mujer llama la atención de los agentes por su comportamiento extraño y por los objetos que lleva consigo. Lo que parece una situación menor pronto levanta sospechas que obligan a los oficiales a investigar más a fondo.

Una serie de incidentes menores durante un patrullaje lleva a los agentes a enfrentarse con personas que no toman en serio las advertencias de la policía. Las bromas y excusas terminan cuando las consecuencias legales entran en juego.

Durante una intervención tensa, un sospechoso se resiste a las órdenes de los agentes y los obliga a utilizar un Taser para controlar la situación. La escena demuestra cómo un encuentro aparentemente simple puede escalar rápidamente.
Paulina y Rafael quieren vivir una historia donde las diferencias económicas no importan y otras personas harán todo lo posible para separarlos.

Una periodista apasionada de las leyendas mexicanas va hacia Xico, Veracruz a investigar sobre la muerte del padre Sebastián que fue encontrado muerto en brazos de una mujer llamada Altagracia del Toro y muchos misterios sin resolver saldrán a luz.

La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

Bazzini Café es un restaurante italiano ubicado en Ridgewood, Nueva Jersey. El Chef Ramsay se dirige hacia allí y debe lidiar con el servicio lento, pobres platos, una deslucida sopa y un decepcionante jefe de cocineros.
Abandoned by their mother and rejected by a cousin, four children turn up at their cantankerous grandmother's (Anne Bancroft).

Richard Feynman (Matthew Broderick) is a talented young physics student at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology when he meets Arline Greenbaum (Patricia Arquette). They quickly fall in love and plan on getting married. But when Arline discovers she has tuberculosis, and Feynman is hired by the government to work on the creation of the atomic bomb, his faith in science is thrown into doubt. This true story about the Nobel Prize-winning physicist was directed by Broderick.

Cantankerous retiree Norman Thayer (Henry Fonda) and his conciliatory wife, Ethel (Katharine Hepburn), spend summers at their New England vacation home on the shores of idyllic Golden Pond. This year, their adult daughter, Chelsea (Jane Fonda), visits with her new fiancée and his teenage son, Billy (Doug McKeon) on their way to Europe. After leaving Billy behind to bond with Norman, Chelsea returns, attempting to repair the long-strained relationship with her aging father before it's too late.

An orphaned young girl, Jane Eyre, suffers humiliation and abuse at the hands of her aunt and is subsequently banished to a strict boarding school for several years. Upon her release, the adult Jane becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall, caring for the child of Mr. Rochester and his ailing wife. Jane and the enigmatic Rochester begin an intense relationship overshadowed by doubt and madness.
A woman starts a support group for patients with Early-Onset Alzheimer's after she is diagnosed with the disease.
Andy and Pete Goodwin have all that matters taken away from them by a powerful family. The brothers seek revenge on the people responsible for them losing everything.
A couple (Ted Danson, Mary Steenburgen) on the verge of divorce rediscover their love for each other when they become stranded together during a snowstorm.
While investigating a woman's death, Frost is led to believe that the husband was responsible, until a priest reveals a man's confession to him.
Frost investigates the armed robbery and later, murder of a pawnbroker and begins to suspect one of the victim's children of the crime.
A stock car champion is killed and his brother, also a racer, is suspect.
A long-time criminal gets out of the nick the same say as a diamond heist takes place.

Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.
Left with a babysitter, a bad boy with a teddy bear finds a pit with four hungry monsters.
Members (Charisma Carpenter, Corin Nemec) of a reality TV show investigate a supposedly haunted house.
Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.
Deadly wasps threaten a small town after a scientist (Michael Shanks) accidentally releases them.
Sailors go to sea to hunt for a prehistoric shark, previously thought to be extinct.

Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.
A giant octopus, mutated from years of radiation exposure, attacks a Navy submarine transporting a terrorist (Ravil Isyanov) captured by a CIA agent (Jay Harrington).

Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.
Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

Unseen forces attack the passengers and crew on an international flight. As the people fight to stay alive, they realize that the unseen forces are the spirits of murdered girls. The spirits try to stop their killer, who is onboard the plane.
Los equipos deben crear cinco platos de carne; un comensal encuentra una desagradable sorpresa en su plato durante la cena; la ronda eliminatoria trae malos humores.
Los equipos sirven un Quinceañero; un desacuerdo entre chefs trae un estanque en la cena; Ramsay toma una decisión inesperada.
Los cocineros compiten entre ellos para participar en una sesión fotográfica y ser los anfitriones de una cena para los miembros del Ejército.
Garth y Lizzy se fugan juntos y se casan. Ella descubre que tiene cáncer, pero no quiere contárselo a Garth hasta no saber sus posibilidades de sobrevivir.
Como consejeros en un campamento para jóvenes con cáncer, Jonathan y Mark ayudan a un ex atleta adolescente con su ira y a un niño cuya madre es sobreprotectora.
Jonathan trata de que Miki, el negligente padre de Jason, se acerque un poco más a su hijo, pero él vive inmerso en su trabajo, evitando el dolor de la enfermedad del joven.
Tanto Mark como Linda tienen opiniones negativas sobre el sexo opuesto. Por eso, piden intercambiar sus vidas y, cuando se les cumple el deseo, aprenden lo que es vivir en el cuerpo del otro.
A Jonathan le toca una de las misiones más difíciles: volver a su antigua casa y ayudar a su viuda a recuperar la alegría de vivir.
Jonathan y Mark deben ayudar a un ángel mal aconsejado, que ha estado tratando de ganar sus alas durante 200 años.
Mark se culpa por una serie de tragedias, y le pide a Jonathan una segunda oportunidad para enmendar las cosas y crear su versión del cielo en la tierra.
Jonathan y Mark reúnen a una madre con su hijo, quien es un importante miembro del gobierno de la URSS. Ella no se da cuenta de que Jonathan es un ángel, y piensa que es un miembro de la CIA.
Una sobreviviente de un campo de concentración nazi necesita un trasplante de corazón, y se entera de que el donante es un terrorista neonazi.
Jonathan y Mark ayudan a un anciano novelista a redescubrir su talento al reencontrarse y conectar con su nieto.
Un hogar para madres solteras está en riesgo, luego de que un reportero de TV acusa a la dirigente del lugar de malversación de fondos.
Una alumna con sobrepeso debe ayudar a un estudiante atleta a salvar el año escolar. Jonathan y Mark motivan a ambos y les dan una lección sobre la amistad.

Jonathan Smith ayuda a los ancianos de un asilo a recuperar su vitalidad, al ofrecer gratis sus servicios de jardinería. Además, dos hermanos, uno de ellos alcohólico, también requieren de la gentileza de Jonathan.
Martin debe tratar a un anciano con un olor horrible. Un presentador de radio local parece tener un problema con la bebida. Julie Mitchell llega a Portwenn.
Culpan a Martín cuando un paciente muere durante un examen. Joan insta a Martín a explicar al viudo las circunstancias que rodean la muerte de Helen.
Martín se ve sorprendido y desconcertado cuando sus padres llegan repentinamente de visita. El examen de Martín a una mujer conduce a un diagnóstico sorpresa.
Un viaje a un restaurante con temática medieval está en juego para el equipo que complete una comida especial para 50 niños y sus madres.
Los equipos deben capturar a unos pollos y preparar cuatro platillos diferentes con los ingredientes que se ganaron en la ronda previa.

El reto consiste en cocinar con lo básico, al vapor, hervido o escalfado, cada participante debe preparar una proteína y hacer un platillo espectacular. En el servicio de este capítulo servirán sashimi en la mesa.
Los restantes 12 concursantes compiten en un desafío intenso y enfrentan la eliminación.
A punto de jubilarse, la inspectora jefe Jane Tennison debe investigar el brutal asesinato de una chica de 14 años.
A punto de jubilarse, la inspectora jefe Jane Tennison debe investigar el brutal asesinato de una chica de 14 años, mientras enfrenta sus problemas de alcoholismo y la muerte de su padre.
Luego de que se produce un asesinato con temática de Jane Austen, Barnaby y Winter descubren que el caso es más siniestro de lo que parece.
When a businessman vanishes, police are led to Pamela Moss, an unassuming woman with terrifying secrets.
Romance novelist Nancy Crampton-Brophy executes the plotline of her own essay "How to Murder Your Husband."
Amanda Taylor gains infamy for posing with the corpse of her father-in-law and a bloody knife.
Natalie Bennett embarks on years of coercively controlling her boyfriend before ending his life with murder.
When the remains of a retired police chief are discovered, police are led to his partner, Marcy Oglesby.
Nick investigates with help from Megan Deputy who's experienced in traditional witchcraft and magic.
Nick tries to make contact with the spirit of a school janitor, John Moll, who is believed to have been murdered.
Nick conducts an incantation that will further increase his chances of making physical contact with an unseen force before he investigates Bloody Mary's infamous haunted house.
Nick investigates Carrie Furnace, a historic landmark with a history of documented paranormal activity.
A killer murders her own son and becomes the first woman to be executed in Florida since 1848.
Steven Dean Gordon and Frank Cano murdered at least four sex workers in California between 2012 and 2013.
Nick tries to contact the spirit of Malinda Niles to see if she'll reveal her cause of death.
The investigation of a missing mother's case exposes a calculated attempt to hide murder in plain sight.
Investigators use CCTV footage to expose the truth behind Grace's disappearance.
Three women reveal how in a moment of passion, they were driven to commit murder.
Two men shot in a drug robbery; 40-year-old drifter fatally shot at a motel by a gang member, Sarah Allen.
A woman who shot her husband and tried to hide his body; a woman is accused of plotting her friend's murder.
Surveillance footage plays a central role in tracking down the killers in two murder cases.
In the United States, a five-year-old boy is found dead after going on a trip to Disneyland with his father; in the United Kingdom, a parking dispute escalates into a double murder.

In the U.S., a woman goes missing with a large sum of money; assuming foul play, the police are running out of time to find her, until someone is caught lying on camera; in the U.K., the shocking murder of a woman in her own home sparks outrage.
Peggy Hilt is convicted of the murder of her two-year-old adopted daughter; Susan D'Aquila is sentenced to 60 years in prison for the murder of her husband.
Celeste Johnson is convicted and sentenced to life in prison; Bernice Ahrens is found guilty of murder and sentenced to 80 years in prison.
A woman is accused of stabbing a teen that she befriended while staying at a mental health facility; a woman is accused of conspiring to murder her pimp.
Dena Thompson targets, defrauds and attacks the men in her life before deciding to murder her husband.

Outlaws threaten to kill Micah unless their leader is freed.
The town drunk's son thinks he is heir to Lucas' ranch.
Lucas and Mark find themselves caring for a 6-month-old baby.
Lucas becomes involved in a revenge fight when he befriends a young Easterner.
Mark runs away from home when he thinks that Lucas believes he's lying.
A buffalo hunter tries to force Lucas into a gunfight.
Land-hungry brothers threaten a spinster's fiancé.
Two tough private detectives appear in North Fork looking for a boy.
A boy is accused of shooting an outlaw in the back.
When a horse dealer transporting a prize stallion stops in North Fork, two saddle tramps try to use trickery to obtain it.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer; the plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
Lucas and Mark find themselves held at gunpoint by a prisoner being transported on a train, which becomes stranded from a plague of grasshoppers.
Mark discovers that the new preacher and his wife are impostors planning a robbery.
Lucas and Marshal Torrance get into trouble with the Army when they try to help a wounded young soldier who deserted.
An old friend of Lucas returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.
Several men are vying for a rancher's daughter's affections; when she is found dead, one of them becomes the prime suspect in her murder.
Shotgun man John Beaumont, who Lucas sent to prison, returns with vengeance on his mind.
After shooting a man in self-defense, Andy Moon and his son turns to Lucas for protection from his vengeful brothers; they take shelter at the McCain ranch.
A bank-robbing gunman decides to hide out at the McCain ranch.
A sharecropper enters his colt in a horse race; he hopes to win enough money to buy a farm from the owner, who has bet on Mark McCain's entry.
Lucas helps his former Army captain, now an undercover federal agent, infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.
Lucas helps a woman who is being harassed by a rough gambler.
An ex-convict is accused of robbing and killing his employer.
Lucas is out for vengeance when Mark is used as a pawn in a bank robbery scheme.
Lucas shoots a horse thief who turns out to be a member of the Boyle clan and now Ma Boyle is after him.
A prison wagon carrying seven criminals stops over in North Fork for supplies.
A con man and his son want Lucas' mineral rights.
A Mexican bandit and his gang ride into North Fork.
The Martinet - A former army captain comes to North Fork to kill the man who shot down his son in a gunfight - Lucas McCain.
A store owner hires con men as collection agents.
Before she dies, the widow of a bandit Lucas shot arranges for his death.
Two unhappy heirs threaten a young widow.
After Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother, he no longer seems interested in getting well.
A convict is released from prison and returns home to North Fork.

When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.
Movie, Science fiction, Romance, Adventure, Action, Drama, Thriller

His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.
Movie, Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery
A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

When ambitious boxer Alain LeFevre refuses to accept a mobster's bribe, he ends up with a price on his head. A marked man, LeFevre takes refuge by enlisting in the French Foreign Legion. After traveling to a remote Moroccan outpost, LeFevre and his regiment suffer repeated attacks at the hands of the Berber rebel army. As he struggles to survive his tenure as a legionnaire, LeFevre dreams of returning to France to find his lady love, Katrina.

A disheveled man who wanders out of the desert, Travis Henderson (Harry Dean Stanton) seems to have no idea who he is. When a stranger manages to contact his brother, Walt (Dean Stockwell), Travis is awkwardly reunited with his sibling. Travis has been missing for years, and his presence unsettles Walt and his family, which also includes Travis's own son, Hunter (Hunter Carson). Soon Travis must confront his wife, Jane (Nastassja Kinski), and try to put his life back together.
Kidnapped by a delusional ex-boyfriend, C.D.'s niece (Shannon Fill) accompanies him on a bank-robbing spree that leaves a trail for bounty hunters and Walker.
Clues in the death of a high-school football coach lead Walker and Trivette to a Las Vegas gambling ring.
The desecration of an American Indian burial ground causes a wicked medicine man to arise from the dead, and Walker must stop the evil.

Dr. Ben Song, lead physicist of a top-secret government time-travel program known as Quantum Leap, makes an unauthorized leap into the past, awakening in a different body with only fragments of his memory intact. Guided by Addison, a colleague in the present day who appears to him as a hologram that only he can see and hear, he discovers the only way for him to leap again is to correct something in his host person's life. As Ben leaps from life to life, putting right what once went wrong, his team in the present tries to figure out why he leaped and bring him home.
Drama, Science fiction, Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Mystery
Reno helps an ex-Army Ranger from his former unit who is wanted for several murders and the hijacking of pharmaceutical trucks.
Reno falls into a trap set by the crooked Lt. Dixon, who is using the Renegade's comatose fiancée as bait.

Self-made millionaire Jonathan and freelance writer Jennifer are the Harts - a globetrotting married couple with a talent for finding mysteries wherever they go. And even when they're uncovering thefts, espionage and assorted skullduggery, they still find time for romance.
Michael jeopardizes his chances for a higher education when he walks out on an IQ test that he feels is unfair to minorities.
The fine print at the bottom of an "easy payment" contract for an encyclopedia set buys the Evanses a lot of trouble.
J.J. reluctantly becomes a member of the Satan's Knights street gang.

Donna wants to marry Fred, but another man proposes to her first.

Hanson must protect a teenage hemophiliac with the AIDS virus from the abuse of classmates and a self-destructive impulse.
Sporty James becomes the subject of a manhunt by both Hunter and the killers of a Colombian drug dealer Sporty once swindled.
Hunter and McCall's only lead in a deaf man's stabbing is a message in sign language given before he died.

Jim Rockford is an ex-con and private detective. He was falsely convicted of a crime he didn't commit, but that doesn't stop him from using his ex-con buddies to help him solve crimes. Nothing comes easy for Rockford, but he works hard and usually gets shot at or beat up at least once per episode.

This week we are celebrating the work of the army of volunteers, which keeps gardens up and down the country looking their best for visitors. Frances Tophill continues her vegetable trials at RHS Rosemoor in Devon, when she plants out her allotment with the help of RHS volunteers, and we visit the Bodnant Garden in North Wales to find out how the volunteers there guide visitors through the world-famous Laburnum Arch.

Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

Monty's thoughts turn to spring when he gives recommendations for bulbs to plant that will thrive in pots. He also shows how to prune summer fruiting raspberries. In Norfolk, Frances Tophill visits a gardener who at 97 still gardens every day.

With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. Vladimir Putin is the modern face of dictatorship, rising out of the ashes of the chaotic Yeltsin years. In the 90s, Putin was a relatively unknown figure who would go on to occupy an untouchable position in a country spanning 11 time zones.
The US and the USSR, two global superpowers, face off for four decades following the Second World War, threatening to annihilate each other with only the push of a button.
As the arms race rages on, the 1950s become a decade of paranoia. The threat of mutually assured destruction maintains the stalemate between democracy and communism.

Russia seals itself behind an Iron Curtain, spawning the birth of revolutions across East Europe as the bitter rivalry between capitalism and communism rages from Berlin to Havana and all the way to Outer Space.
The stakes couldn't be higher in the 60s as the USSR places nuclear warheads in Cuba, the first US troops arrive in Vietnam, and the world witnesses the moon landing.
By the 1970s Stalin is long gone, but Russia's determination strengthens. Advances in nuclear technology have poured fuel on the fire in the international arms race.
By the end of the 70s, war between East and West has been raging for decades. Countless proxy wars have proven how destructive the so-called Cold War can be.
The struggle between communism and capitalism moves to its next battleground in the 1980s, right in the backyard of the United States. President Reagan announces his new weapons program, Star Wars.

In 1989, the USSR pulls out of Afghanistan and the last remaining proxy conflict of the Cold War ends. A new era emerges as brutal barriers are broken down. A peaceful transition is what the watching world prays for, but is by no means a sure thing.

Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.
Hitler is born in Austria, before leaving school early and being rejected from art school twice. He later joins the Bavarian Army in World War I, and finally starts to feel like he belongs.

Hitler becomes a police informer at the NSDAP, and soon becomes a leader. He tries to lead a coup in 1923, but their attempt fails and Hitler ends up in jail for a year. During this time, he writes 'Mein Kampf'.

Hitler finishes his time in prison and re-establishes the NSDAP, which steadily gains more votes during the economic crisis of the 1930s. President von Hindenburg refuses to appoint Hitler as Chancellor, so Hitler must find another means of power.

The President of the NSDAP appoints Hitler as Reich Chancellor, expecting him to get rid of the communists. Hitler has other plans in mind, and uses lies and violence to get rid of his political opponents.
Hitler rises to power and becomes Chancellor and President; the Nuremberg Race Laws are passed.
Thanks to the economic boom, Hitler's popularity starts to increase; he promotes the construction of motorways and promises the Germans an affordable car: the famous Volkswagen.
Hitler and Goebbels begin a pogrom night against the Jews; Hitler sets up a secret life in Obersalzberg and conceals his mistress Eva Braun from the public eye.
Hitler breaches the Munich Agreement and claims further territories for Germany.
An exploration of Hitler's life, his political manoeuvres, and his rise to power during World War II.
Hitler forgoes his pact with Stalin and invades Russia with the mission to destroy the whole population and gain land in Eastern Europe for his supreme race.

An in-depth examination of some of the most stunning and emotional courtroom moments caught on camera. A former soldier wages a one-man war against deadly terrorists who hold his niece hostage at a soccer game.

At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.
Robert Gunther Bendik is renowned as the world's greatest hitman. A group of self-obsessed assassins team up to take Gunther out, determined to claim the title for themselves.

When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.
Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.
The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

With the help of his girlfriend, Sherry (Allison Hayes), Cheney Holland (Don Megowan) breaks out of prison intent on hunting down the men responsible for killing his kid brother. After chasing down a gang of outlaws led by Isaac Stancil (Gerald Milton), Holland is himself pursued by dogged marshal Matt Gordon (Jim Davis). But Holland refuses to turn from his quest for revenge, forcing Gordon to apprehend Sherry and use her to bait Holland into a final showdown.
Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

The western town of Mesa City, Ariz., is a haven for a ruthless gang of cowboys, led by the villainous Joe Brooke (Dennis Moore). Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), a retired gunslinger, is wrangled back into action to fight back against Brooke and his boys. But Roberts will not face them alone. His gang of Rough Riders -- the Rev. Tim McCall (Tim McCoy) and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) -- are ready and willing to help Roberts kick Brooke out of town for good.
A radio-singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) turns sheriff to save a sheep woman (Ruth Terry) from a cattleman (Paul Kelly).
A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.
A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.
A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

Gabby Whittaker (George "Gabby" Hayes) runs the Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes. At the boys' graduation, Gabby's friend Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) performs. Roy later grows concerned when one of the boys, Chip (Tommy Cook), receives a visit from his outlaw father, King Blaine (Lyle Talbot). Chased away by the sheriff, Blaine is shot and killed, leaving Chip a pawn between Blaine's gang and Roy -- who knows Blaine left the take from his last robbery with his son.

On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.
A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

Dare Rudd (John Wayne) and Dinkey (Syd Saylor) are two friends who love to gamble. Needing money and shelter, they travel to Montana to visit Rudd's cousin, Tom (John Mack Brown), who owns a successful cattle ranch. Dare quickly falls for Tom's girlfriend Judy (Marsha Hunt), who convinces Tom to give Dare a chance to prove himself by running a cattle drive. When he loses the herd in a high-stakes poker game, Dare joins forces with Tom and Dinkey to get the cattle back.

One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

Convinced of his irresistible appeal to women, Texas dishwasher Joe Buck (Jon Voight) quits his job and heads for New York City, thinking he'll latch on to some rich dowager. New York, however, is not as hospitable as he imagined, and Joe soon finds himself living in an abandoned building with a Dickensian layabout named Enrico Ratso Rizzo (Dustin Hoffman). The two form a rough alliance, and together they kick-start Joe's hustling career just as Ratso's health begins to deteriorate.

The story of a middleweight boxer as he rises through ranks to earn his first shot at the middleweight crown. He falls in love with a gorgeous girl from the Bronx. The inability to express his feelings enters into the ring and eventually takes over his life. He eventually is sent into a downward spiral that costs him everything.

When the world's greatest treasures, including the Pink Panther diamond, are stolen, only one man can solve the mystery: Clouseau (Steve Martin). Together with his partner Ponton (Jean Reno) and a team of international detectives, the bumbling detective must catch the thief and retrieve the artifacts -- without causing too much collateral damage.

In this first film of the beloved comic series, dashing European thief Sir Charles Lytton (David Niven) plans to steal a diamond, but he's not the only one with his eyes on the famous jewel known as the "Pink Panther." His nephew George (Robert Wagner) also aims to make off with the gem, and to frame Charles for the crime. Blundering French police inspector Jacques Clouseau (Peter Sellers) intercedes, but finds his career -- and his freedom -- jeopardized.

When the coach of a French soccer team is killed, his ring featuring the legendary Pink Panther diamond goes missing. Luckily, Chief Inspector Dreyfus has a plan: assign his most intelligent, most driven officers to track down the thieves in secret, while publicly assigning the bumbling Inspector Jacques Clouseau as head of the case. Clouseau seems hopeless, until his various mistakes and misjudgments miraculously put him on the real killer's trail.

Foolish life insurance salesman Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) commits his biggest blunder yet when he unwittingly offers a six-figure policy to notorious gunslinger Jesse James (Wendell Corey). Furious, his boss orders him to repurchase the policy. James, however, parries Farnsworth's attempts with ease, robbing and humiliating him. But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

Melody Jones (Gary Cooper) is a laid-back cowboy who gets lost on the trail and ends up in the small town of Payneville. Seeing the initials "MJ" on his saddle, the people of Payneville mistake Jones for the treacherous bandit Monte Jarrad (Dan Duryea), and they nearly kill him before he is rescued by Cherry de Longpre (Loretta Young). Grateful for her help, Jones falls for Cherry, not knowing that she is Jarrad's girl and that she plans on using him to help Jarrad elude capture.

Headstrong Thomas Dunson (John Wayne) starts a thriving Texas cattle ranch with the help of his faithful trail hand, Groot (Walter Brennan), and his protégé, Matt Garth (Montgomery Clift), an orphan Dunson took under his wing when Matt was a boy. In need of money following the Civil War, Dunson and Matt lead a cattle drive to Missouri, where they will get a better price than locally, but the crotchety older man and his willful young partner begin to butt heads on the exhausting journey.

As the winter of 1867 approaches, Denver inhabitants led by chronic drunk Oracle Jones (Donald Pleasence), who has visions when inebriated, realize with horror that their supply of whiskey will run out before the snows melt. Oracle devises a plan to bring cases of whiskey from a distillery, but is thwarted at every turn. A temperance leader (Lee Remick), three Sioux Indians, and the U.S. Cavalry become interested in the shipment, and a sandstorm and quicksand add to the difficulties.

Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalp hunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

Proud warrior Navajo Joe (Burt Reynolds) is the only man left alive when outlaw Marvin Duncan (Aldo Sambrell) and his brutal gang destroy his village. Riding into a nearby town of white settlers, Joe announces his plans for vengeance, but the townspeople fear Duncan's retribution too much to stand behind him. In the course of his one-man battle against Duncan's small army for control of the town, Joe falls for beautiful maid Estella (Nicoletta Machiavelli).

Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about.
A dude (Terence Hill) arrives from New England with books and a bicycle, ready to claim his father's rowdy ranch.

Confederate soldiers Jerry Brewster (Thomas Hunter) and Ken Seagull (Nando Gazzolo) steal a fortune from the U.S. Army. But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagull escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance.

Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. In the winter of 1944, American soldiers led by Will Knott (Ethan Hawke) are assigned to capture a small squad of German soldiers posted in France's Ardennes forest. Tired of war, the Americans have already lost half their division and discover that their German enemy is equally unwilling to fight. With Jewish soldier Stan Shutzer (Arye Gross) interpreting, the Germans and Americans agree on a plan that will let the former surrender without violence -- but then, tragedy strikes.

Looking to escape her unhappy marriage, villainous femme fatale Bridget Gregory (Linda Fiorentino) convinces her husband, Clay (Bill Pullman), to sell cocaine, then steals the profits and runs out on him. She stops in a small town en route to Chicago, where she ensnares her next conquest, insurance man Mike Swale (Peter Berg). After getting a job at his insurance company, Bridget convinces Mike to run a scam -- but things take a deadly turn when she recruits him to help get rid of her husband.

Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.
A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.
Troubled 9-year-old Dom has a stuffed dinosaur that comes to life.
A teenager's investigation into his father's death leads him to a hidden city populated with menacing warriors.

Happily married Michael (Kurt Russell) and Karen Carr (Madeleine Stowe) call the police after a failed robbery. Officer Pete Davis (Ray Liotta) arrives and helps arrange the installation of a new security system. The grateful Carrs have Pete to dinner and strike up a friendship. Pete invites Michael to ride with him during a night's patrol and gives him the chance to beat up the burglar. Michael refuses and tells the disturbed cop to stay away, but Pete begins stalking the terrified couple.
Two Fern Gully faeries leave the rain forest to save three baby animals from poachers.

Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

A staunch advocate of healthy living, Dr. John Harvey Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) opens a sanitarium that promotes his progressive, if eccentric, ideas about optimal well-being. Among the clients who arrive at the facility are the opportunistic Charles Ossining (John Cusack), who is keen on marketing Kellogg's cereal, and the wealthy Will Lightbody (Matthew Broderick) and his wife, Eleanor (Bridget Fonda). This comedy is inspired by an actual spa run by Dr. Kellogg at the turn of the century.

In a small New Hampshire town, washed-up cop Wade Whitehouse (Nick Nolte) has a troubled past, an abusive father (James Coburn), the contempt of his ex-wife (Mary Beth Hurt) and an unimpressive streak as a lawman. When hunting guide Jack Hewitt (Jim True) reports a businessman's accidental death during a hunting trip, Wade believes he has a chance to turn around his life, if he can prove it was murder. Increasingly obsessed, Wade begins to lose his composure during the investigation.

When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.
A teacher (Colin Firth), obsessed with soccer and a team that hasn't won a league cup in 18 years, begins a shaky relationship.

Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

Ten years after a plague turns most of the world's population into vampires, a critical blood shortage causes panic and gruesome mutations among the reanimated. Edward (Ethan Hawke), a vampire hematologist, tries to develop a blood substitute when he meets Lionel (Willem Dafoe) and Audrey (Claudia Karvan), two fugitive humans who claim to have a possible cure. Edward casts his lot with them in the hope of perfecting the cure before it's too late.

Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.
Brigitte is found and taken to rehab; the wolfsbane serum is a narcotic.

In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.
Heir to a line of werewolves, a teenager (Landon Liboiron) battles a pack of beasts and his own lust for blood.

Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

When Jessica moves back into her childhood home with her family, her youngest stepdaughter, Alice, finds a stuffed bear named Chauncey. As Alice's behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize that Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

Johnny Cobb (James Stewart) is the part-time sheriff in a small, rundown town, trying to stretch his meager salary to provide for his growing family. Poor Cobb isn't much of a gunman, and he isn't particularly suited for fighting, but he's the man in charge when a gang of bandits led by Bob Larkin (Henry Fonda) rides into town. The tension rises as the bandits make themselves at home in Cobb's town, but when a gunfight breaks out, Cobb finds himself pushed to the limit.

When locals are wrongfully led to believe that Wes Tancred murdered a gunslinger in cold blood, they exile the innocent man. Tancred sets off in search of a new start and arrives in the dusty hamlet of Table Rock -- only to find his reputation has preceded him. To avoid trouble, Tancred uses an assumed name. But, when Sheriff Fred Miller talks of trouble at the hands of a violent gang, Tancred agrees to be deputized, and struggles for his shot at redemption.
A wagon master is confronted by a man he wounded years before in episodes from "The Travels of Jamie McPheeters."

When a yearly high-stakes poker game begins between the five richest men in Laredo, Texas, all other activity in the Wild West town comes to a stop as everyone gathers to watch the action. When the stress of the game becomes too much to bear, his disapproving wife, Mary (Joanne Woodward), must step in to save the family fortune.

Reduced to transporting gold from a distant mine to a small-town bank, retired lawman Steve Judd (Joel McCrea) recruits friend Gil Westrum (Randolph Scott), who has been performing in a traveling carnival. This is a filmed documentary of what could very loosely be termed the "African Woodstock." In 1971, several prominent African-Americans convinced the government of Ghana to hold a gala concert to commemorate that nation's 14th anniversary of independence. Some of the big American names participating in the resulting 14-hour event are Santana, Wilson Pickett and Roberta Flack, while African artists are represented by such acts as Kofi Ghanaba and the Kumasi Drummers.

The programme visits La Gondola in Derby, a hotel and restaurant owned and run by businesswoman Daniela Bayfield. The restaurant's decor, staff and food are all stuck in the past.

Gordon tackles a pub for the first time, getting to grips with The Fenwick Arms in rural Lancashire. Despite their best endeavours Brian and his partner Elaine are £250,000 in debt, and are losing £1,500 a week.

For the last three years Morgan's has been run by antiques dealer-turned-restaurateur Sandy and her daughters Helen and Laura. The beautifully-designed dining room has a prime high street location and should be the perfect eatery for the trendy local clientele, but head chef Phil is grappling with an eclectic menu that includes mashed potato with apricots, and his cooking's just not up to it. Can Gordon help?

For the last 18 months ex Michelin-starred chef Nick has owned and run Rococo, but his past success is now eluding him. The menu is past its sell-by date, the service is stuffy, the food is over-priced and the only thing being fed is his ego. With debts of £100k, Gordon forces him to face his failures, strips down the menu and dismantles the claustrophobic dining room.

Gordon Ramsay is back with his trademark mix of tough talking and inspirational leadership for another foray into some of the country's scariest kitchens. The venue is Ruby Tate's in Brighton, owned and run by ex-actor and failed Hollywood wannabe Allan Love. For Gordon, his trip to Piccolo Teatro turns into one of his biggest nightmares yet. Will he be able to perform a miracle, or admit defeat?

Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.
Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

El grupo se prepara para su más feroz batalla y los caminos de Rick y Morgan se alejan. Mientras tanto, el pasado de Carol regresa para acecharla.

Tras haber obtenido un éxito menor, algunos de los miembros del grupo han sido hechos prisioneros por sus nuevos enemigos y el resto de los supervivientes de Alejandría tendrá que tratar de liberarlos.

Abraham abandona a Eugene durante una misión porque él le dice que no necesita su protección. Daryl, Rosita y Denise se topan con un grupo de los Salvadores, dirigidos por Dwight, y entre los dos bandos se produce un tiroteo.
Carol desaparece de Alejandría y toda la comunidad se coordina para localizarla. Sin embargo, lo que algunos de ellos encuentran no es lo que andaban buscando.
Para salvar a Maggie, que se encuentra enferma, el grupo de Rick se aventura fuera de los muros de Alejandría. Pero los hombres de Negan los están esperando en la carretera.

Se descubre contra quién ha ejecutado Negan su venganza. Después, lleva a Rick a hacer un viaje que este no olvidará jamás, con la intención de mostrarle hasta dónde llega su poder y cómo va a cambiar la vida de todos los protagonistas.
Carol y Morgan son conducidos hasta una comunidad que parece segura y bien abastecida. Todo resulta tan idílico, que la desconfianza ante lo que están presenciando aflora en ellos.

Negan mantiene a Daryl encerrado en una celda, pero le propone que se someta a él y pasará a disfrutar de los privilegios de los que gozan los suyos. Se descubre el pasado de Dwight y por qué tiene la cara desfigurada.

Los miembros del grupo de Alejandría están desmoralizados debido a los trágicos acontecimientos que acaban de ocurrir, pero al mismo tiempo deben prepararse para el encuentro con Negan. Este llega antes de lo previsto y les arrebata las armas.

Afligidas por la pena y rodeadas de enemigos, Maggie y Sasha tratan de encontrar seguridad en Hilltop, pero allí no son bien recibidas por todos. En ese momento, los hombres de Negan llegan a Hilltop, adonde también se dirigen Carl y Enid.

Tara llega a un poblado en el que solo viven unas peligrosas mujeres que no la dejarán salir de ahí fácilmente. Mientras tanto, Heath, quien la acompañaba en la búsqueda de provisiones, se pierde tratando de escapar de un ataque zombi.

Carl se separa de Jesús y llega, oculto en un camión, a la guarida de los Saviors con la intención de matar a Negan. Mientras tanto, Rosita fuerza a Eugene a que le fabrique una bala y Michonne pone en marcha su propio plan contra Negan.

Negan continúa su visita a Alejandría. Spencer trata de entablar amistad con él para que lo designe líder de la comunidad, en lugar de Rick. Pero en ese momento Rick llega y se desencadena una serie de acontecimientos.
Guiados por Jesús, Rick y sus compañeros llegan hasta la comunidad del rey Ezequiel, para buscar aliados en su lucha contra Negan. Allá se reencuentran con un viejo conocido.
Mientras buscan a Gabriel, Rick y el grupo se topan con una misteriosa región cuyos habitantes son completamente diferentes a todo lo que han conocido hasta ahora.
